generic.Defined scope/population: All claimed locations and scheduled items on the policy term in force at the date of loss.
generic.In-scope period: Policy term inception through the date of loss, including mid-term endorsement transactions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Scheduled premises number, item description, stated value and loss payee fields complete in PolicyCenter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items claimed on the FNOL equal items matched to the schedule plus items flagged unscheduled.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Locations and Scheduled Items screens saved to ClaimCenter with capture date and policy term version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each unscheduled or mismatched item is logged and routed to the coverage analysis step.
generic.Test population: All location and schedule verification notes on claims opened in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the note omits the scheduled premises number or any matched item reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Unscheduled items go to coverage analysis and coverage status stays open until resolved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Loss address matches a scheduled premises and every claimed item is matched or flagged.
generic.Evidence location: Policy Verification subsection of the coverage section of the claim file in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Open the Locations tab on the in-force term in PolicyCenter
sop: Open the policy term whose effective dates bracket the date of loss, not the current renewal term.
Select the Locations tab and list every scheduled premises number with its full address.
Done when the scheduled premises list for the in-force term is on screen.
verify: Check the term shown on the header matches the term attached to the claim.
Pass when the location list belongs to the term in force at the date of loss.

steps.title: Match the FNOL loss address to a scheduled premises number
sop: Compare the loss address on the FNOL to each scheduled address line by line including unit and suite detail.
Record the matching scheduled premises number on the coverage verification note in ClaimCenter.
Where no premises matches, mark the location unscheduled rather than selecting the nearest address.
Done when the loss address is tied to a premises number or marked unscheduled.
verify: Re-read the FNOL address against the recorded premises number.
Pass when the recorded premises number resolves to the same street address as the FNOL.

steps.title: Match each claimed item to the schedule in PolicyCenter
sop: List the items claimed from the FNOL such as scheduled jewellery, equipment or a vehicle identified by VIN.
Locate each item on the Scheduled Items tab and record its schedule line and stated value.
Done when every claimed item has a schedule line reference or an unscheduled marker.
verify: Count claimed items against matched plus unscheduled items.
Pass when the two counts are equal with no item left unassessed.

steps.title: Check mid-term endorsements adding or deleting the location or item
sop: Open the transaction history for the term in PolicyCenter and filter to endorsements issued before the date of loss.
Read each endorsement that touches locations or scheduled property and note its effective date.
Record whether the location or item was on risk at the date of loss after the endorsement effect.
Done when every relevant endorsement is read and its effect recorded.
verify: Compare each endorsement effective date to the date of loss.
Pass when on-risk status at the date of loss is stated for the location and every item.

steps.title: Copy loss payees and mortgagees to the ClaimCenter party list
sop: Read the loss payee and mortgagee entries recorded against the affected location on the declarations.
Add each party to the claim party list in ClaimCenter with the correct role and loan reference.
Done when every listed payee for the affected location appears on the claim party list.
verify: Compare the declarations payee list to the claim party list.
Pass when no declarations payee for that location is missing from the claim.

steps.title: Route unscheduled items to coverage analysis in ClaimCenter
sop: Create an activity for each item marked unscheduled and assign it to the coverage analysis step.
State in the activity why the item is not on the schedule and what the claimant asserts.
Done when every unscheduled item has an open coverage analysis activity.
verify: List open activities against unscheduled items.
Pass when each unscheduled item has one open activity and none is closed without a coverage answer.

steps.title: Write the location and schedule verification note in ClaimCenter
sop: Write a note naming the scheduled premises number, each matched item and its schedule line.
List the endorsements relied on with their effective dates and the payees added to the claim.
Attach the Locations and Scheduled Items screen captures to the coverage section.
Done when the dated note and its attachments are saved to the claim.
verify: Open the coverage section and read the note as a reviewer would.
Pass when the note names the premises number and every matched item without needing the source system.

generic.Defined scope/population: The reported date of loss tested against the effective and expiration dates of the retrieved policy term.
generic.In-scope period: Policy term inception to expiration, including any cancellation or reinstatement transaction.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Date of loss, term effective date, term expiration date and trigger basis are populated on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One in-term check result exists for each claim with a retrieved policy term and no claim is unchecked.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Term dates screen saved to the claim with the capture date and the transaction version viewed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Boundary or out-of-term dates are logged as coverage in question and routed to coverage analysis.
generic.Test population: All claims with a date-of-loss-in-term check recorded during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the check result omits either the term effective date or the term expiration date.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-term losses are never closed at this step and go to coverage analysis with status in question.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The date of loss falls inside the term after allowing for the 12:01 a.m. convention and any cancellation.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage verification note on the claim record in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Confirm the date of loss from the FNOL and reporting party statement
sop: Read the date of loss from the FNOL intake field in ClaimCenter.
Compare it to the reporting party statement text and to any first notice recording summary.
Where the two differ, record both and mark the date of loss as unconfirmed pending clarification.
Done when the date of loss is confirmed or explicitly marked unconfirmed.
verify: Check the claim date-of-loss field against the statement quoted in the note.
Pass when the field and the statement agree or the discrepancy is recorded.

steps.title: Read term effective and expiration date and time in PolicyCenter
sop: Open the retrieved term in PolicyCenter and record the effective and expiration date with the time of day.
Apply the 12:01 a.m. standard time convention shown on the declarations rather than assuming midnight.
Done when both boundary date and time values are recorded on the claim.
verify: Compare the recorded values to the declarations page header.
Pass when recorded dates and times match the declarations exactly.

steps.title: Confirm the correct trigger date for the form basis
sop: Identify whether the coverage form is occurrence based or claims made and reported.
Select the trigger date accordingly, the occurrence date or the claim made and report date.
Record which trigger date is being bracketed so a reviewer can follow the test.
Done when the trigger basis and trigger date are recorded on the claim.
verify: Check the trigger basis against the coverage form retrieved.
Pass when the trigger date used matches the basis stated on the form.

steps.title: Check cancellation, non-renewal and reinstatement transactions
sop: Open the transaction history for the term in PolicyCenter and list every status changing transaction.
Record the effective date of any cancellation, non-renewal or reinstatement that shortens the term.
Done when the effective term end date after transactions is recorded.
verify: Compare the stated term expiration to the effective end date after transactions.
Pass when any shortening transaction is reflected in the end date used for the test.

steps.title: Run the in-term test and record the result in ClaimCenter
sop: Test the trigger date against the effective start and the effective end of the term.
Record the result as in term, boundary or out of term with the two term dates cited in the note.
Done when the dated in-term check result is saved on the claim.
verify: Read the check result and recompute the comparison from the cited dates.
Pass when the recorded result follows from the cited term dates.

steps.title: Route boundary and out-of-term results to coverage analysis
sop: Where the result is boundary or out of term, set the coverage status to in question in ClaimCenter.
Open a coverage analysis activity describing the date conflict in one sentence.
Do not close or deny the claim at this step on date grounds alone.
Done when the status is set and the analysis activity is open.
verify: Check the claim status and open activities for every non in-term result.
Pass when no boundary or out-of-term claim sits without an open coverage analysis activity.

generic.Defined scope/population: The billing account and instalment history for the policy term responding to this claim.
generic.In-scope period: Term inception to the date of loss, extended to any reinstatement effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium status, last payment date, cancellation notice date and reinstatement date are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Instalments billed equal instalments paid plus instalments recorded as outstanding at the date of loss.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Billing status screen saved to the claim showing the as-at date used for the check.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any past due instalment or cancellation notice is logged with its disposition on the coverage note.
generic.Test population: All claims with a premium status finding recorded during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if billing evidence for the date of loss is absent or the finding is not one of the defined values.
generic.Exception handling path: Cancelled non-pay findings go to coverage analysis before any coverage confirmation is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premium status at the date of loss is recorded as current, in grace or cancelled non-pay with evidence.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage verification note and billing evidence attachment on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Open the billing account for the term in PolicyCenter
sop: Locate the billing account linked to the policy term in force at the date of loss.
List each instalment with its due date, paid date and amount.
Done when the instalment history for the term is retrieved.
verify: Check the account shown belongs to the term attached to the claim.
Pass when the instalment history is for the responding term.

steps.title: Test whether any instalment was past due at the date of loss
sop: Compare each instalment due date to the date of loss and mark any unpaid at that date.
Record the amount and age of any past due instalment on the coverage note.
Done when the past due position at the date of loss is stated.
verify: Recompute the past due test from the listed due and paid dates.
Pass when the stated position follows from the instalment history.

steps.title: Check for a non-payment cancellation notice and its effective date
sop: Search the term transactions in PolicyCenter for a notice of cancellation for non-payment.
Record the notice issue date and the stated cancellation effective date and time.
Done when the presence or absence of a non-pay cancellation notice is recorded.
verify: Check the recorded notice details against the transaction record.
Pass when the notice dates on the claim match the policy system transaction.

steps.title: Confirm proof of mailing and the statutory notice period
sop: Where a cancellation notice exists, retrieve the proof of mailing record for that notice.
Confirm the days between mailing and the cancellation effective date meet the jurisdiction requirement.
Do not treat the policy as off risk until both proof and notice period are satisfied.
Done when the mailing proof and notice period test result are recorded.
verify: Recount the notice days from the mailing date to the cancellation effective date.
Pass when the counted days meet or exceed the required notice period or the shortfall is recorded.

steps.title: Check reinstatement effectiveness and any lapse-in-coverage gap
sop: Locate any reinstatement transaction and record its effective date and time.
Read the lapse in coverage clause on the reinstatement to see whether the gap period is excluded.
Done when the reinstatement effective date and any gap period are recorded.
verify: Compare the date of loss to the reinstatement effective date and the gap period.
Pass when the claim states whether the loss falls inside a lapse gap.

steps.title: Record the premium status finding and attach billing evidence
sop: Record the finding on the coverage verification note as current, in grace or cancelled non-pay.
Attach the billing status screen capture showing the as-at date used.
Where the finding is cancelled non-pay, open a coverage analysis activity before any confirmation.
Done when the finding, evidence and any routing activity are saved.
verify: Open the coverage note and confirm the finding value and attachment are present.
Pass when the finding is one of the three defined values with billing evidence attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims that have completed policy match, term, party and premium verification and need a preliminary coverage note.
generic.In-scope period: From claim assignment to 24 hours after assignment, the window the confirmation must be issued in.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage verification status, verification date, policy number, limits and deductible fields are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Coverage parts named in the note equal the exposures opened on the claim in ClaimCenter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Declarations PDF and billing screenshot attached to the coverage section with capture dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unresolved verification step is logged in the note as an open item rather than left silent.
generic.Test population: All claims assigned during the review period that reached preliminary coverage confirmation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the status field is unset or the note is dated more than 24 hours after assignment.
generic.Exception handling path: Where a prior denial or ROR exists, the note is held and routed to coverage analysis for reconciliation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated preliminary confirmation note exists with limits, deductible and documents relied on listed.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage section of the claim file in ClaimCenter and the linked document repository folder.

steps.title: Confirm no prior denial, ROR or coverage letter exists on the claim
sop: Search the claim correspondence log in ClaimCenter for issued coverage position letters.
Record the result so the preliminary note cannot contradict an issued position.
Done when the correspondence log has been checked and the result recorded.
verify: Re-run the correspondence search filtered to coverage document types.
Pass when no issued coverage letter is unaccounted for in the note.

steps.title: Set the coverage verification status field to Confirmed-Preliminary
sop: Open the coverage verification panel on the claim in ClaimCenter.
Set the status to Confirmed-Preliminary and stamp the verification date.
Done when the status and verification date are saved.
verify: Reopen the claim and read the status and date fields.
Pass when both fields are populated and the date is not in the future.

steps.title: Write the coverage note listing policy, coverage parts, limits and deductible
sop: Record the policy number, term dates and each coverage part triggered by the reported loss.
Record the limit and deductible applying to each coverage part named.
List the documents relied on such as declarations, endorsements and billing evidence.
Done when the note carries policy, coverage, limits, deductible and document list.
verify: Compare the limits and deductible in the note to the declarations page.
Pass when every figure in the note matches the declarations.

steps.title: Attach the declarations PDF and billing screenshot to the coverage section
sop: Upload the declarations page PDF for the in-force term to the coverage section of the claim file.
Upload the billing status screenshot used for the premium check with its capture date.
Done when both documents are attached and typed correctly in the repository.
verify: Open the coverage section and list its attachments.
Pass when both documents are present with the correct document type set.

steps.title: Add the non-waiver caveat to the preliminary confirmation
sop: Add wording stating the confirmation is preliminary and issued without waiver of any policy term or defence.
Note that further investigation may change the position and that no right is being given up.
Done when the caveat wording appears in the saved note.
verify: Read the note for the non-waiver wording.
Pass when the caveat is present and unambiguous.

steps.title: Confirm the note is filed within 24 hours of assignment
sop: Compare the note timestamp to the claim assignment timestamp in ClaimCenter.
Where the window has been missed, record the reason on the claim rather than backdating.
Done when the elapsed time is checked and any breach reason is recorded.
verify: Recompute elapsed hours from assignment to note timestamp.
Pass when elapsed time is within 24 hours or a recorded reason explains the breach.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims where a coverage fact conflicts with the rated policy and an underwriting or mid-term audit answer is needed.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the discrepancy to receipt of the audit or endorsement response.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage unclear indicator, reason code, referral text and diary date are populated on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims carrying the coverage unclear indicator equal open underwriting referrals raised from claims.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Declarations page and the conflicting claim fact attached to the referral with upload timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals returned without an answer are logged and re-raised rather than silently closed.
generic.Test population: All claims with the coverage unclear indicator set during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a flagged claim has no reason code or no open diary date.
generic.Exception handling path: No coverage confirmation or denial is issued while the audit flag is open and the hold is logged.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An underwriting or mid-term audit referral exists with a reason code and an open diary.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting referral record on the policy term and the coverage log on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: State the coverage discrepancy in one sentence on the claim
sop: Describe what the claim facts show and what the policy as rated shows in a single sentence.
Name the document or observation that creates the conflict.
Done when the one sentence discrepancy statement is saved to the coverage log.
verify: Read the statement without the claim context.
Pass when an underwriter could identify the conflict from the sentence alone.

steps.title: Set the coverage unclear indicator and reason code in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the coverage unclear or underwriting referral indicator on the claim.
Select the reason code that fits, such as unscheduled item, class mismatch, exposure not rated or missing endorsement.
Done when the indicator and reason code are saved.
verify: Reopen the claim and read the indicator and reason code.
Pass when both are set and the reason code matches the discrepancy statement.

steps.title: Raise the underwriting or mid-term audit referral in PolicyCenter
sop: Raise the referral against the policy term in force at the date of loss.
Paste the one sentence discrepancy statement into the referral body.
Record the referral reference back on the claim so the two records are linked.
Done when the referral exists and its reference is recorded on the claim.
verify: Open the referral from the claim using the recorded reference.
Pass when the referral opens and names the same discrepancy.

steps.title: Attach declarations and the conflicting claim fact to the referral
sop: Attach the declarations page for the in-force term to the referral.
Attach the conflicting evidence such as the photograph, invoice or statement.
Done when both the policy document and the claim evidence are on the referral.
verify: List the referral attachments.
Pass when the declarations and at least one conflicting claim document are attached.

steps.title: Set a diary for the audit or endorsement response
sop: Set a claim diary for the expected referral response date with a named owner.
Title the diary with the referral reference so it can be closed on receipt.
Done when the diary is open and assigned.
verify: Check the claim diary list for the referral entry.
Pass when an open diary with a future due date and named owner exists.

steps.title: Record the coverage position hold in the coverage log
sop: Write a coverage log entry stating no confirmation or denial will be issued while the audit flag is open.
Record the date the hold started and the referral it depends on.
Done when the hold entry is saved to the coverage log.
verify: Check whether any coverage letter was issued after the hold date.
Pass when no coverage position letter is issued while the hold entry remains open.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every named insured, additional insured, loss payee and mortgagee on the responding policy term.
generic.In-scope period: Policy term inception to the date of loss, including party changing endorsements.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Party name, entity suffix, party role and loan or account reference are populated on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parties on the declarations and endorsements equal parties added to the claim party list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Declarations page and each additional insured endorsement saved with form number and edition date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claimants with no policy standing are flagged on the party list rather than omitted.
generic.Test population: All claims where a party list was built during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any declarations party is missing from the claim or carries the wrong party role.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed standing is recorded with the reason and routed to coverage analysis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim party list holds every insured, additional insured and loss payee with correct roles.
generic.Evidence location: Claim party list in ClaimCenter with policy documents in the Policy Documents folder.

steps.title: List named insureds exactly as printed on the declarations
sop: Copy each named insured from the declarations page including trading names and trust or entity suffixes.
Do not normalise or abbreviate the legal name when recording it.
Done when every named insured is recorded verbatim on the claim.
verify: Compare each recorded name character by character to the declarations.
Pass when the recorded names match the declarations exactly.

steps.title: Read every additional-insured endorsement in PolicyCenter
sop: Open each additional insured endorsement listed on the declarations schedule.
Record for each whether coverage is granted for ongoing operations, completed operations or both.
Record the form number and edition date beside each additional insured.
Done when every additional insured endorsement has been read and summarised.
verify: Compare the endorsement list on the declarations to the summaries recorded.
Pass when no listed additional insured endorsement is unread.

steps.title: Record loss payees and mortgagees with loan references
sop: Read the loss payee and mortgagee entries from the declarations or the lender endorsement.
Record each with its loan or account reference and the location it attaches to.
Done when every payee is recorded with its reference.
verify: Compare payees recorded against the declarations and lender endorsement.
Pass when each payee carries a loan or account reference.

steps.title: Test policy definitions where the claimant is not a named insured
sop: Open the policy form definitions for spouse, resident relative and permissive user.
Test the claimant facts against each definition and record the result.
Done when the claimant standing under the definitions is recorded.
verify: Read the definition quoted against the claimant facts recorded.
Pass when the standing conclusion follows from the quoted definition.

steps.title: Add every party to the claim with the correct role in ClaimCenter
sop: Add each party with the role Insured, Additional Insured or Loss Payee as applicable.
Ensure the party record carries the address of record so correspondence reaches them.
Done when every identified party exists on the claim with a role and address.
verify: Compare the identified party count to the claim party list count.
Pass when the counts agree and each party carries a role.

steps.title: Flag claimants with no policy standing on the party list
sop: Mark any claimant who cannot be tied to a named insured, endorsement or definition as standing disputed.
Record in one sentence why standing is not established.
Route the disputed party to coverage analysis rather than removing them from the claim.
Done when every disputed claimant is flagged with a reason.
verify: List claim parties with disputed standing.
Pass when each disputed party carries a reason and a coverage analysis activity.

generic.Defined scope/population: Candidate policy terms returned by search for the reported loss identifiers.
generic.In-scope period: The term in force at the date of loss rather than the current renewal term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured name, VIN or address and the matched term dates are populated on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each claim links to exactly one responding policy term with no duplicate policy attachment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Search result and matched term screen saved to the claim with the capture date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched or multi-candidate searches are logged with the selection rationale or an unmatched disposition.
generic.Test population: All claims where a policy was attached during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the attached term dates do not bracket the date of loss or fewer than two identifiers agree.
generic.Exception handling path: No match found routes the claim to policy research rather than proceeding to coverage analysis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim links to a policy term whose effective dates bracket the date of loss on two agreeing identifiers.
generic.Evidence location: Policy panel on the claim in ClaimCenter and the match note in the coverage section.

steps.title: Search PolicyCenter by policy number first
sop: Enter the policy number from the FNOL into the PolicyCenter policy search.
Record whether the search returns a term, no result or multiple terms.
Done when the policy number search result is recorded.
verify: Compare the searched number to the FNOL field.
Pass when the number searched matches the number reported.

steps.title: Search on secondary identifiers where the policy number fails
sop: Search by VIN or registration, by insured name plus postcode, or by FEIN.
Record each identifier searched and the candidate terms returned.
Done when at least one candidate term is found or the claim is marked unmatched.
verify: Review the identifiers searched against those available on the FNOL.
Pass when every available identifier was searched before marking unmatched.

steps.title: Confirm the candidate term is the one in force at the date of loss
sop: Open the candidate policy term history and select the term whose dates bracket the date of loss.
Reject the current renewal term where the loss falls in a prior term.
Done when the in-force term is identified and recorded.
verify: Compare the selected term dates to the date of loss.
Pass when the date of loss falls inside the selected term.

steps.title: Verify at least two identifiers agree before attaching
sop: Compare two independent identifiers such as VIN and named insured or address and FEIN.
Record both matching identifiers on the match note.
Where only one identifier agrees, hold the attachment and seek clarification.
Done when two agreeing identifiers are recorded or the match is held.
verify: Read the match note for the two identifiers recorded.
Pass when two independent identifiers are named and both agree.

steps.title: Record the selection rationale where multiple policies could respond
sop: Where a fleet, multi location or layered program returns several candidates, list them all.
State in one sentence why the selected policy is the responding one.
Done when the rationale and the rejected candidates are recorded.
verify: Read the rationale against the candidate list.
Pass when each rejected candidate is explained rather than ignored.

steps.title: Attach the policy in ClaimCenter and confirm coverage structure populated
sop: Attach the selected policy term to the claim using the policy system integration.
Confirm the coverage structure and limits populated from the policy rather than manual entry.
Done when the claim shows a system populated coverage structure.
verify: Compare populated coverages and limits to the declarations page.
Pass when the coverage structure matches the declarations and shows no manual override.

generic.Defined scope/population: The declarations page and every endorsement form listed on the declarations schedule for the in-force term.
generic.In-scope period: Term inception to the date of loss, including mid-term endorsement transactions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each retrieved document carries a form number, edition date and document type in the repository.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms listed on the declarations schedule equal forms retrieved plus forms noted as missing.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Documents indexed to the Policy Documents folder with retrieval date and edition date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any form referenced but not retrievable is logged with a follow-up action to obtain it.
generic.Test population: All claims with a policy document retrieval recorded during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any scheduled endorsement form is neither retrieved nor logged as missing.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing forms are requested from underwriting and the coverage position waits on the answer.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Declarations plus every scheduled endorsement form are indexed to the claim Policy Documents folder.
generic.Evidence location: Policy Documents folder of the claim file in the document repository.

steps.title: Download the declarations page for the in-force term from PolicyCenter
sop: Select the term whose dates bracket the date of loss and download its declarations page.
Record the edition date printed on the declarations.
Done when the declarations PDF and its edition date are captured.
verify: Compare the declarations term dates to the date of loss.
Pass when the declarations belong to the responding term.

steps.title: Pull the endorsement schedule from the declarations
sop: List every form number and edition date shown on the declarations endorsement schedule.
Record the list as the retrieval checklist for this claim.
Done when the full scheduled form list is recorded.
verify: Count the forms listed on the declarations against the checklist.
Pass when the checklist count equals the schedule count.

steps.title: Download every listed endorsement form by number and edition
sop: Download each form on the checklist using its exact number and edition such as CG 20 10 04 13.
Download all listed forms rather than only those that appear relevant to the loss.
Done when every checklist form is downloaded or marked unavailable.
verify: Tick each checklist form against the downloaded set.
Pass when no checklist form is left without a download or an unavailable marker.

steps.title: Note any form referenced on the declarations but not retrievable
sop: Compare the checklist to the retrieved set and list the gaps.
Raise a request to underwriting for each missing form and record the request date.
Done when every gap has a recorded request.
verify: List forms marked unavailable and their requests.
Pass when each unavailable form has an open request recorded.

steps.title: Retrieve mid-term endorsement transactions issued before the loss
sop: Filter the term transaction history to endorsements effective between inception and the date of loss.
Download the endorsement document for each such transaction.
Done when every pre-loss mid-term endorsement document is retrieved.
verify: Compare transaction count to endorsement documents retrieved.
Pass when each pre-loss endorsement transaction has a document.

steps.title: Index all documents to the claim Policy Documents folder
sop: Upload the declarations and every form to the Policy Documents folder of the claim file.
Set the document type and record form number and edition date on each index entry.
Done when the folder holds the full document set with indexing complete.
verify: Open the folder as a reviewer and list its contents against the checklist.
Pass when counsel or QA could reconstruct the same document set from the folder alone.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every coverage part shown on the declarations for the responding term tested against the reported loss.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term in force at the date of loss as amended by pre-loss endorsements.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage code, limit, deductible and applicability conclusion are recorded for each part.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Coverage parts on the declarations equal parts assessed plus parts explicitly noted as not triggered.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Declarations coverage schedule saved with edition date and the assessment note dated.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parts purchased but not obviously triggered are logged as available with a disposition.
generic.Test population: All claims with a coverage applicability assessment recorded during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an exposure is opened against a coverage code not identified as applicable in the assessment.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous applicability routes to the insuring agreement mapping step before exposures are opened.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exposures are opened against the specific coverage codes identified as applicable on the declarations.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage assessment note and exposure records on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: List declarations coverage parts with limits and deductibles
sop: List each coverage part on the declarations such as Building, Business Personal Property, Liability or Collision.
Record the limit and deductible shown against each part.
Done when every declarations coverage part is listed with its limit and deductible.
verify: Count listed parts against the declarations coverage schedule.
Pass when the counts agree and no part is omitted.

steps.title: State in one line whether each part could respond to the reported loss
sop: For each part, state whether the reported cause of loss and damage type could fall within it.
Base the statement on the reported facts rather than on the claimant characterisation.
Done when every listed part carries a one line applicability statement.
verify: Read each statement against the reported cause of loss.
Pass when every part has a stated conclusion and none is left blank.

steps.title: Confirm the peril basis of each property coverage in PolicyCenter
sop: Open the property coverage form and identify whether it is named peril or special form all risk.
For named peril forms, confirm the reported peril appears on the covered causes of loss list.
Done when the peril basis and the peril test result are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded basis to the coverage form retrieved.
Pass when the basis stated matches the form and the peril test follows from it.

steps.title: Note purchased coverages not obviously triggered
sop: Check the declarations for parts such as ordinance or law, debris removal and loss of use.
Record each as available with a note on what would trigger it on these facts.
Done when each non obvious coverage is recorded as available or not applicable.
verify: Compare declarations parts to the availability notes.
Pass when no purchased coverage is missing from the availability list.

steps.title: Set triggered coverages on the claim exposure records
sop: Open an exposure in ClaimCenter for each coverage identified as applicable.
Select the exact coverage code from the policy structure rather than a generic code.
Done when one exposure exists for each applicable coverage.
verify: List exposures and their coverage codes against the applicability assessment.
Pass when every exposure code appears in the assessment as applicable.

steps.title: Confirm reserves attach to the correct coverage line
sop: Check that each reserve set sits on the exposure for its coverage rather than a default line.
Correct any reserve posted to the wrong coverage before saving.
Done when every reserve sits on the matching coverage exposure.
verify: Compare the reserve ledger to the exposure coverage codes.
Pass when no reserve sits on a coverage not identified as applicable.

generic.Defined scope/population: All limits, sublimits and deductibles applying to the triggered coverages on the responding term.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term in force at the date of loss including prior payments made in that term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Per occurrence limit, aggregate limit, sublimit, deductible basis and remaining aggregate are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Prior paid plus outstanding plus remaining aggregate equals the term aggregate limit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Declarations limits schedule and the paid loss extract saved with as-at dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Near exhaustion and defence cost erosion effects are logged with the action taken.
generic.Test population: All claims where limits and deductibles were computed during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the deductible basis is not stated or the sublimit test is absent where a sublimit exists.
generic.Exception handling path: Aggregate near exhaustion is escalated to the handler and excess carriers are put on notice.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Limits, sublimits, deductible and remaining aggregate are recorded with the calculation basis stated.
generic.Evidence location: Limits and deductible calculation note on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Record per occurrence and aggregate limits for each triggered coverage
sop: Read the per occurrence and aggregate limits from the declarations for each triggered coverage.
Record whether the aggregate is per policy, per location or per project.
Done when both limit values and the aggregate basis are recorded per coverage.
verify: Compare recorded limits to the declarations limits schedule.
Pass when every figure matches the declarations.

steps.title: Identify sublimits capping the claimed loss type
sop: Search the forms and endorsements for sublimits on water damage, mould, theft of money, data or ordinance and law.
Where a sublimit applies to the claimed loss type, apply the lower of the limit and the sublimit.
Record the sublimit and the form it comes from.
Done when the effective cap for the claimed loss type is recorded.
verify: Check the applied cap against the sublimit and the base limit.
Pass when the recorded cap equals the lower of the two.

steps.title: Apply the correct deductible basis and show the calculation
sop: Identify the deductible basis as flat amount, percentage of value, per unit or named storm.
Where the basis is a percentage, show the percentage applied against the stated value in the note.
Done when the deductible amount and its calculation are recorded.
verify: Recompute the deductible from the stated value and percentage shown.
Pass when the recomputed amount equals the recorded deductible.

steps.title: Pull prior paid and outstanding amounts on the same term
sop: Extract paid and outstanding amounts for all claims on the same policy term from ClaimCenter.
Record the as-at date of the extract.
Done when the term erosion figures are recorded with an as-at date.
verify: Reconcile paid plus outstanding to the extract total.
Pass when the recorded figures tie to the extract.

steps.title: Compute remaining aggregate and flag near exhaustion
sop: Subtract prior paid and outstanding from the term aggregate to get remaining aggregate.
Flag the claim where remaining aggregate is below the current exposure reserve.
Done when remaining aggregate is recorded and any near exhaustion flag is set.
verify: Recompute remaining aggregate from the recorded inputs.
Pass when the arithmetic ties and the flag matches the computed position.

steps.title: Confirm whether defence costs erode the limit under this form
sop: Read the supplementary payments or defence cost provision in the coverage form.
State whether defence costs sit inside or outside the limit and the effect on available indemnity.
Done when the defence cost treatment and its indemnity effect are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded treatment to the form wording cited.
Pass when the stated treatment is supported by the cited provision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ambiguous policy wording or novel fact patterns on this claim that the handler cannot resolve unaided.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the ambiguity to receipt and recording of counsel response.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date, paragraph reference and the closed question are populated on the request.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Questions asked equal answers recorded plus questions still open on the consultation record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consultation request and response filed with dates in the legal matter and the claim privileged folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Questions counsel declines to answer are logged with the reason and the alternative route taken.
generic.Test population: All coverage consultations raised on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the privileged note omits the form number or the clause at issue.
generic.Exception handling path: Where counsel needs more facts, the investigation step is reopened before the position is set.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A privileged coverage note records the counsel response with the form number and clause cited.
generic.Evidence location: Privileged coverage note on the claim and the matter record in the legal matter management system.

steps.title: Quote the ambiguous wording verbatim in the consultation request
sop: Copy the wording exactly from the form as endorsed rather than from a summary.
Record the form number, edition date and paragraph reference beside the quotation.
Done when the request carries the verbatim wording and its citation.
verify: Compare the quoted text to the policy document character by character.
Pass when the quotation and citation match the retrieved form.

steps.title: Attach declarations, the full form and material facts to the request
sop: Attach the declarations page and the complete form containing the clause at issue.
Attach the statements and reports counsel needs to answer the question.
Include adverse facts rather than a favourable selection.
Done when the attachment set is complete on the request.
verify: List the attachments against the facts referenced in the question.
Pass when every fact relied on in the question has a supporting attachment.

steps.title: Frame a closed coverage question for counsel
sop: Write the question as whether the named clause bars or limits this loss on these facts under the governing law.
Name the jurisdiction whose law is to be applied in the answer.
Avoid open requests to advise generally.
Done when the question is closed, jurisdiction specific and answerable yes or no.
verify: Read the question and test whether it can be answered without a further call.
Pass when the question names a clause, facts and a jurisdiction.

steps.title: Open or update the consultation matter in the legal matter system
sop: Open the consultation under the claim number with the matter type set to coverage advice.
Record the question set and the response deadline on the matter.
Done when the matter exists with the question set and deadline recorded.
verify: Open the matter from the claim reference.
Pass when the matter carries this claim number and the stated question set.

steps.title: Record the response in a privileged coverage note
sop: Record counsel response in a note marked Attorney-Client Privileged on the claim.
Cite the form number and clause at issue inside the note.
Restrict access to the privileged folder and confirm the restriction applies.
Done when the privileged note is saved with access restricted.
verify: Attempt to open the note from a non privileged claim role.
Pass when the note is inaccessible to unrestricted roles and cites the clause.

steps.title: Translate the advice into a plain handling instruction
sop: Write a non privileged coverage log entry stating the handling step to take.
Do not reproduce counsel reasoning or analysis in the non privileged log.
Done when the handling instruction is recorded without privileged content.
verify: Read the non privileged entry for any reproduced legal analysis.
Pass when the entry directs handling without disclosing counsel reasoning.

generic.Defined scope/population: The coverage decision for each exposure on the claim after insuring agreement and exclusion review.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the coverage analysis to the date the position is stamped on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage position value, decision date, rationale note and authority check are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposures on the claim equal exposures carrying a coverage position with no exposure left unset.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated rationale note retained with the forms and clauses cited and the analysis version referenced.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Facts still under investigation are logged so a covered with reservation position stays defensible.
generic.Test population: All claims with a coverage position set during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the position carries no rationale note or the note cites no policy form and clause.
generic.Exception handling path: Positions above handler authority are escalated to manager or counsel before being saved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coverage position is set with a dated rationale citing at least one policy form and clause.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage position panel and rationale note on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Set the coverage position field and stamp the decision date
sop: Select Covered, Covered-with-ROR, Partially Covered or Denied on the coverage position panel.
Stamp the decision date as the date the analysis concluded, not the letter date.
Done when position and decision date are saved on the claim.
verify: Reopen the claim and read the position and decision date.
Pass when both are set and the date is not in the future.

steps.title: Write the basis citing insuring agreement and each exclusion applied
sop: State whether the insuring agreement is satisfied and why in one paragraph.
List each exclusion applied with its form number and clause reference.
Done when the basis note names the agreement and every exclusion relied on.
verify: Check each cited clause against the retrieved policy documents.
Pass when every citation exists in the policy as endorsed.

steps.title: Separate established facts from facts still under investigation
sop: List the facts treated as established and the evidence establishing each.
List the facts still open and the investigation step that will close them.
Done when the fact status list is recorded on the coverage note.
verify: Compare the open fact list to the reservations relied on in the position.
Pass when every reserved question maps to an open fact.

steps.title: Confirm the decision is within settlement and denial authority
sop: Compare the exposure amount to the handler authority band for this line.
Where the exposure exceeds the band, route to the manager or counsel before saving.
Record the authority check result on the coverage note.
Done when the authority check is recorded or the escalation is raised.
verify: Compare exposure value to the recorded authority band.
Pass when the decision maker authority covers the exposure or an escalation exists.

steps.title: Escalate to the specialist where the position is complex or high value
sop: Review the draft position and basis where the claim meets the large loss or complexity trigger.
Record agreement or the changes required before the position is saved.
Done when the specialist review outcome is recorded on the claim.
verify: Check the review record date against the position decision date.
Pass when the review predates the saved position on qualifying claims.

steps.title: Reconcile reserves and exposures to the saved position
sop: Check each exposure disposition against the coverage position saved.
Close or zero any covered reserve sitting on an exposure now recorded as denied.
Done when reserve and exposure records agree with the position.
verify: List exposures with open reserves and compare to positions.
Pass when no denied exposure retains an open indemnity reserve.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every unresolved coverage provision to be reserved in the draft reservation-of-rights letter.
generic.In-scope period: From the coverage position decision date to the date the draft is submitted for review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Template edition, provisions quoted, factual issues and recipient list are populated on the draft.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open coverage questions equal provisions reserved in the draft plus questions marked not requiring reservation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft version saved to the claim with its version number and the template edition used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Provisions considered but not reserved are logged with the reason on the coverage log.
generic.Test population: All ROR drafts prepared on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any reserved provision is paraphrased rather than quoted with form number and edition date.
generic.Exception handling path: Wording counsel disputes is amended before review approval rather than issued with a caveat.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Draft quotes each reserved provision in full with form number and edition date and names the open facts.
generic.Evidence location: Draft ROR document attached to the coverage section of the claim file.

steps.title: Open the approved ROR template for the line and jurisdiction
sop: Select the ROR template matching this line of business and the governing jurisdiction.
Confirm the template edition is the current one in the correspondence library.
Done when the current template edition is opened and its edition recorded.
verify: Compare the template edition used to the library current edition.
Pass when the edition used is current.

steps.title: Quote each provision relied on in full with citation
sop: Insert the full text of each insuring agreement, condition and exclusion relied on.
Place the form number and edition date immediately beside each quotation.
Do not paraphrase or summarise a provision being reserved.
Done when every reserved provision appears in full with its citation.
verify: Compare each quotation to the retrieved form.
Pass when every quotation matches the source form text.

steps.title: State the factual issue leaving each provision unresolved
sop: For each provision, state the specific fact that is not yet established.
State the investigation step continuing on that fact.
Done when every reserved provision carries a factual issue and an investigation step.
verify: Read each provision paragraph for a factual issue and next step.
Pass when no reserved provision lacks a stated open fact.

steps.title: Include non-waiver and continuing investigation language
sop: Confirm the letter reserves the right to add further grounds later.
Confirm the non waiver clause and the statement that investigation continues are present.
Confirm no wording reads as a coverage determination or denial.
Done when the reservation language is confirmed present and correct.
verify: Read the letter as a policyholder would for any determination wording.
Pass when the letter reserves rather than determines coverage.

steps.title: Build the recipient list from the claim party list
sop: Address the letter to every named and additional insured tendering the claim.
Add the insured representative or counsel where the insured is represented.
Use the address of record held on the policy for each party.
Done when the recipient list covers every tendering insured and representative.
verify: Compare the recipient list to the claim party list.
Pass when no tendering insured is missing from the recipients.

steps.title: Attach the versioned draft to the claim for review
sop: Save the draft with a version number to the coverage section of the claim file.
Record the template edition and the provisions reserved on the coverage log entry.
Done when the versioned draft and its log entry are saved.
verify: Open the attached draft and check its version and citations.
Pass when the attached draft quotes each reserved provision with form number and edition date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every exclusion and policy condition in the base form and endorsements for the responding term.
generic.In-scope period: The term in force at the date of loss with wording as amended by pre-loss endorsements.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exclusion reference, determination value and, where fact dependent, the missing fact are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exclusions and conditions in the forms equal entries in the analysis with a determination recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis note retained with the form numbers and edition dates of the wording reviewed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Fact dependent exclusions are logged with the investigation step that will resolve them.
generic.Test population: All coverage analyses completed on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any exclusion is left without an applies, does not apply or fact dependent determination.
generic.Exception handling path: Exclusions whose effect is unclear route to coverage counsel before a position is taken.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The analysis lists each exclusion and condition considered with a recorded determination.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage analysis note in the coverage section of the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Work the base form exclusion list in order
sop: Open the base coverage form exclusions section and take each exclusion in printed order.
Mark each as applies, does not apply or fact dependent against the reported loss.
Done when every base form exclusion carries a determination.
verify: Count exclusions in the form against determinations recorded.
Pass when the counts agree with no exclusion skipped.

steps.title: Apply endorsements that add, delete or amend exclusions
sop: List endorsements touching exclusions such as pollution, fungi, cyber, professional services or wear and tear.
Replace the base wording with the amended wording where an endorsement changes it.
Done when the analysis uses the wording as endorsed for every exclusion.
verify: Spot check three amended exclusions against the endorsement text.
Pass when the analysis quotes the endorsed wording rather than the base wording.

steps.title: Name the missing fact for each fact-dependent exclusion
sop: For each fact dependent determination, state the single fact that would settle it.
Name the investigation step that will produce that fact and its owner.
Done when every fact dependent exclusion has a missing fact and a next step.
verify: List fact dependent exclusions against open investigation activities.
Pass when each has an open activity that would resolve it.

steps.title: Assess the policy conditions separately from the exclusions
sop: Review late notice, cooperation, concealment or fraud, protective safeguards and other insurance.
Record a determination for each condition since conditions bar coverage independently.
Done when every relevant condition carries its own determination.
verify: Check the analysis for a conditions section distinct from exclusions.
Pass when each listed condition has a determination of its own.

steps.title: Test exceptions to any exclusion before concluding it bars coverage
sop: For each exclusion marked applies, read its exception wording such as ensuing loss or sudden and accidental.
Test the reported facts against the exception and record the result.
Done when every applied exclusion records its exception test.
verify: Read each applied exclusion for its exception test result.
Pass when no exclusion is concluded to bar coverage without an exception test.

steps.title: Save the exclusions and conditions analysis to the claim
sop: Record the analysis as a dated note listing each exclusion and condition with its determination.
Cite the form number and edition date of every wording relied on.
Done when the dated analysis note is saved in the coverage section.
verify: Open the note and confirm every entry carries a determination and a citation.
Pass when a reviewer can reconstruct the determinations from the note alone.

generic.Defined scope/population: The coverage position letter and every recipient entitled to receive it on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the date the coverage position was set to the jurisdictional response deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Issue date, despatch method, recipient list and document ID are populated on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entitled recipients on the party list equal addressees on the issued letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued letter version, despatch proof and tracking receipt saved to the claim file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable or returned mail is logged with the re-issue action taken.
generic.Test population: All coverage position letters issued on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the issue date falls after the calculated jurisdictional deadline or despatch proof is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: A deadline at risk is escalated so an interim status communication is issued before it lapses.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Letter, despatch proof and issue date are recorded on the claim inside the jurisdictional deadline.
generic.Evidence location: Correspondence log of the claim in ClaimCenter with documents in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Calculate the jurisdictional response due date
sop: Identify the response deadline for this line and jurisdiction from the compliance reference.
Calculate the due date from the date the coverage position was set.
Done when the due date is recorded on the claim.
verify: Recount the days from the position date to the recorded due date.
Pass when the recorded due date matches the jurisdictional rule.

steps.title: Build the recipient list from the addresses of record
sop: List every named and additional insured plus the insured representative.
Use the address of record held on the policy for each recipient.
Done when the recipient list is complete with addresses.
verify: Compare the recipient list to the claim party list.
Pass when no entitled party is missing from the recipients.

steps.title: Insert the jurisdiction-required consumer content
sop: Add the appeal or reconsideration route available to the insured.
Add the department of insurance contact details and any prescribed notice text.
Done when all required consumer content is present in the letter.
verify: Check the letter against the jurisdiction content checklist.
Pass when every required content item is present.

steps.title: Despatch by the method the file requires
sop: Use certified or tracked mail where the position is adverse to the insured.
Send to every recipient on the list on the same date.
Save the tracking receipt for each despatch to the claim file.
Done when all recipients are despatched and receipts are saved.
verify: Compare tracking receipts to the recipient list.
Pass when a receipt exists for every adverse position recipient.

steps.title: Record issue date, method, recipients and document ID
sop: Record the issue date, despatch method and recipients on the claim correspondence log.
Record the document ID of the issued version so the exact letter can be retrieved.
Done when the correspondence log entry is complete.
verify: Open the correspondence entry and retrieve the letter by its document ID.
Pass when the retrieved document is the version despatched.

steps.title: Close the compliance clock and handle returned mail
sop: Confirm the compliance timer closes on the recorded issue date.
Where mail is returned undelivered, log it and re-issue to a verified address.
Done when the timer is closed and any returned mail is dispositioned.
verify: Compare the recorded issue date to the calculated due date.
Pass when the issue date is on or before the due date with no undispositioned returned mail.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each element of every insuring agreement that could respond to the reported loss.
generic.In-scope period: The policy period of the responding term measured against the applicable trigger date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Element, policy definition quoted, reported fact and conclusion are recorded for each element.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Elements in the insuring agreement equal elements addressed in the mapping note.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mapping note retained with form number and edition date of the agreement mapped.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Elements not satisfied are logged and carried into the coverage position rather than dropped.
generic.Test population: All coverage analyses with an insuring agreement mapping during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any element is addressed without quoting the policy definition of its defined terms.
generic.Exception handling path: Contested element definitions route to coverage counsel before the exclusion review begins.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The note addresses every element separately with the policy definition quoted.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage analysis note in the coverage section of the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Break the insuring agreement into its elements
sop: List the elements such as bodily injury or property damage, caused by an occurrence, during the policy period.
Include the coverage territory element where the form contains one.
Done when the element list is recorded for the agreement being mapped.
verify: Compare the element list to the agreement text.
Pass when no element in the wording is missing from the list.

steps.title: Quote the policy definition of each defined term
sop: Open the Definitions section of the form and copy the definition of every defined term used.
Record each definition beside the element it belongs to.
Done when every defined term in the element list carries its policy definition.
verify: Compare quoted definitions to the form Definitions section.
Pass when each quotation matches the form text.

steps.title: Test the reported facts against each definition
sop: For each element, state the reported facts and whether they satisfy the quoted definition.
Name the evidence source for each fact relied on.
Done when every element carries a satisfied or not satisfied conclusion.
verify: Read each conclusion against the facts and definition recorded.
Pass when every conclusion follows from the quoted definition.

steps.title: Confirm the trigger element against the loss chronology
sop: Identify the trigger as occurrence date, first manifestation or claim made and reported date.
Compare the trigger date to the established loss chronology on the claim.
Done when the trigger element result is recorded with its date.
verify: Compare the trigger date used to the chronology evidence.
Pass when the trigger date is supported by the chronology.

steps.title: Map the facts to every coverage part that could respond
sop: Where several coverage parts could respond, repeat the element mapping for each.
Identify which part responds primarily and record why.
Done when each candidate part has a mapping and the primary part is named.
verify: Compare mapped parts to the applicable coverages identified earlier.
Pass when every applicable coverage part has a mapping.

steps.title: Record the element-by-element mapping in the coverage analysis
sop: Save the mapping as a dated note in the coverage section citing form number and edition date.
State whether the insuring agreement is satisfied so the exclusion review can start from it.
Done when the mapping note is saved with a stated agreement conclusion.
verify: Read the note for a stated insuring agreement conclusion.
Pass when the exclusion review can begin from the recorded conclusion.

generic.Defined scope/population: Authority in the governing jurisdiction on the specific policy clause at issue on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: Authority current at the research date including any pending appellate decision noted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Governing jurisdiction, clause researched, citations and contrary authority are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Clauses referred for research equal clauses covered by the research summary.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Research summary saved to the privileged folder with the research date and citation list.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Clauses with no on point authority are logged with the analogous authority relied on instead.
generic.Test population: All coverage research summaries filed on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the summary does not name the governing jurisdiction or cites no authority.
generic.Exception handling path: Conflicting authority is escalated so the coverage position accounts for the litigation risk.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The summary names the governing jurisdiction and cites the authority relied on.
generic.Evidence location: Privileged section of the claim file with the matter record in the legal matter system.

steps.title: Determine which jurisdiction law governs the policy
sop: Check the policy for a choice of law clause and record it if present.
Where absent, apply the insured domicile and the place of contracting analysis.
Done when the governing jurisdiction and the reason for it are recorded.
verify: Read the recorded reason against the policy and the insured details.
Pass when the jurisdiction conclusion follows from the recorded factors.

steps.title: Search authority on the clause by form language
sop: Search for decisions construing the exact wording of the clause rather than the claim type.
Record the citation, court, year and holding for each relevant decision.
Done when the search on the clause wording is complete and cited.
verify: Compare the searched wording to the clause quoted from the form.
Pass when the authority cited construes the same wording.

steps.title: Check for departmental bulletins and market conduct guidance
sop: Search the jurisdiction regulator publications for bulletins touching this clause or claim type.
Record any guidance that overrides or supplements the case law.
Done when the regulatory check is complete and its result recorded.
verify: Check the summary for a stated regulatory search result.
Pass when the summary states whether guidance exists or none was found.

steps.title: Record the jurisdiction construction rules that change the outcome
sop: Record whether contra proferentem applies to ambiguous wording in this jurisdiction.
Record whether the efficient proximate cause rule or anti concurrent causation enforcement applies.
Done when the applicable construction rules are recorded with citations.
verify: Compare the recorded rules to the authority cited for each.
Pass when every stated rule carries a supporting citation.

steps.title: Record contrary authority found during the search
sop: List decisions that cut against the position being considered.
State how they are distinguished or why they present risk.
Done when contrary authority is listed and addressed.
verify: Read the summary for a contrary authority section.
Pass when contrary authority is either cited or expressly recorded as none found.

steps.title: File the research summary to the privileged claim folder
sop: Upload the summary to the privileged section of the claim file with the privilege designation applied.
Record the matter reference so the summary and the legal matter tie together.
Done when the summary is filed with privilege applied and cross referenced.
verify: Attempt to open the summary from an unrestricted claim role.
Pass when access is restricted and the matter reference resolves.

generic.Defined scope/population: The complete policy for the responding term including declarations, common conditions, coverage form and endorsements.
generic.In-scope period: The term in force at the date of loss with endorsements effective on or before that date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date and read status are recorded for every document reviewed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms listed on the declarations schedule equal forms recorded as read in the review note.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated policy review note retained naming each form and its edition date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Forms unavailable at review time are logged and the review reopened when they arrive.
generic.Test population: All claims with a policy review note recorded during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any scheduled form is absent from the review note or carries no edition date.
generic.Exception handling path: Condition deadlines discovered during the review are diarised before the review is closed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated review note lists every form and endorsement read with its edition date.
generic.Evidence location: Policy review note in the coverage section of the claim file.

steps.title: Assemble the policy in reading order in the document repository
sop: Order the documents as declarations, common conditions, coverage form, then endorsements in schedule order.
Save the assembled order as the reading set for this claim.
Done when the reading set is assembled in the claim Policy Documents folder.
verify: Open the folder and check the document order against the schedule.
Pass when the assembled order follows the declarations schedule.

steps.title: Reconcile endorsement form numbers and editions to the schedule
sop: Compare each endorsement form number and edition date to the declarations schedule entry.
Note any endorsement that amends the core wording of the coverage form.
Done when every endorsement is reconciled and amendments are noted.
verify: Spot check three endorsements against the schedule entries.
Pass when form number and edition date agree for each checked endorsement.

steps.title: Read the Definitions section and mark relevant defined terms
sop: Read the Definitions section of the coverage form in full.
Mark every defined term that appears in the clauses relevant to this loss.
Done when the marked defined term list is recorded on the claim.
verify: Compare the marked terms to the clauses relied on in the analysis.
Pass when every defined term used in the analysis appears on the marked list.

steps.title: Read the Conditions section and extract the deadlines
sop: Read duties after loss, appraisal, suit limitation and other insurance conditions.
Record each deadline the conditions impose with the date it falls due.
Done when every condition deadline is recorded on the claim.
verify: Compare recorded deadlines to the conditions text.
Pass when each deadline recorded is supported by a quoted condition.

steps.title: Diary the condition deadlines in ClaimCenter
sop: Create a diary for each condition deadline with a named owner.
Title each diary with the condition it protects so it can be closed cleanly.
Done when every recorded deadline has an open diary.
verify: Compare the recorded deadline list to the open diaries.
Pass when each deadline has one open diary with an owner.

steps.title: Record the dated policy review note
sop: Write a note listing every form read with its number and edition date.
State the reading order used so a reviewer can reconstruct the same document set.
Done when the dated review note is saved to the coverage section.
verify: Rebuild the document set from the note alone.
Pass when the note yields the same forms and editions as the folder.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every ROR event on this claim from drafting through issue, supplement and withdrawal.
generic.In-scope period: From the coverage position decision date to the date the last reservation is withdrawn.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Event type, actor, date, letter version and reserved provisions are populated per log entry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: ROR events on the claim equal coverage log entries with an attached letter version.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each entry carries the exact letter version sent with its version number and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Superseded drafts are marked superseded rather than deleted from the log.
generic.Test population: All claims with ROR activity logged during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any ROR event has no log entry or no attached letter version.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps between the decision date and the issue date are investigated and explained on the log.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The coverage log holds a dated entry for every ROR action with its letter version attached.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage log on the claim in ClaimCenter with documents in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Create a coverage log entry for each ROR event
sop: Log the event type as drafted, reviewed, issued, supplemented or withdrawn.
Record the actor and the date for each event as it happens rather than in arrears.
Done when every ROR event has its own dated log entry.
verify: List ROR events on the claim against log entries.
Pass when every event has one entry with an actor and date.

steps.title: Attach the exact letter version to each log entry
sop: Attach the document version relevant to that event, not the latest version.
Mark superseded drafts as superseded so the issued version is distinguishable.
Done when each entry carries the correct letter version.
verify: Open the issued entry and compare its attachment to the despatched document ID.
Pass when the issued entry attachment is the version actually sent.

steps.title: Record recipients and despatch method on the issued entry
sop: Record every recipient of the issued letter on the issued log entry.
Record the despatch method and the proof of mailing reference.
Done when recipients, method and proof reference are on the issued entry.
verify: Compare the issued entry recipients to the claim party list.
Pass when no entitled recipient is missing from the entry.

steps.title: Record the reserved provisions on each entry
sop: List the form number and clause of each provision reserved in that letter version.
Keep the list in the same order as the letter so reconciliation is straightforward.
Done when reserved provisions are recorded on each relevant entry.
verify: Reconcile the entry provision list to the open coverage question list.
Pass when every open question maps to a reserved provision or an explicit exclusion from reservation.

steps.title: Check for a gap between decision date and issue date
sop: Compare the coverage position decision date to the ROR issue date on the log.
Where a gap exists, record the reason for the interval on the log.
Done when the interval is measured and any gap is explained.
verify: Read the log chronologically for unexplained intervals.
Pass when the log runs from decision to issue with no unexplained gap.

steps.title: Reconcile the log against the correspondence record
sop: Compare the coverage log entries to the claim correspondence log for coverage documents.
Add any missing entry and record the omission reason.
Done when the two records agree.
verify: Count ROR documents in correspondence against issued log entries.
Pass when the counts agree with no unlogged ROR document.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every open coverage question on this claim and the policy provisions that govern each.
generic.In-scope period: From the open coverage question list date to the date the draft is submitted for review.
