generic.Required fields populated and valid: Provision text, form number, edition date and plain language explanation are populated per question.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open coverage questions equal provisions cited in the draft plus questions marked as not reservable.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft saved with its version number and a change marker where it updates a prior ROR.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Questions dropped from the draft are logged with the reason on the coverage log.
generic.Test population: All ROR drafts and updates prepared on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any cited provision is paraphrased or lacks a form number and edition date.
generic.Exception handling path: New provisions identified during drafting are added to the open question list before review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The draft cites the provision for every open question verbatim with form number and edition date.
generic.Evidence location: Draft ROR document attached to the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Pull the open coverage question list from the claim
sop: Open the coverage question list in ClaimCenter and export the unresolved rows.
Confirm each row names the provision that governs the question.
Done when the unresolved question set is in front of the drafter.
verify: Count unresolved rows against the questions carried into the draft.
Pass when every unresolved row is accounted for in the draft or logged as not reservable.

steps.title: Quote each provision in full with form number and edition date
sop: Copy the insuring agreement, definition, exclusion or condition text from the form as endorsed.
Place the form number and edition date beside each quotation in the draft.
Done when every cited provision is quoted with its citation.
verify: Compare each quotation against the retrieved policy documents.
Pass when every quotation matches the source form as endorsed.

steps.title: Explain in plain language why each provision may limit coverage
sop: Write one short paragraph per provision explaining its potential effect on the current facts.
Avoid claim codes, internal jargon and reserve references.
Done when every provision carries a plain language explanation.
verify: Read each explanation as a policyholder would.
Pass when the effect is understandable without policy expertise.

steps.title: Mark newly added provisions when updating an existing ROR
sop: Where this draft updates a prior ROR, mark the newly added provisions clearly.
Preserve every previously reserved provision rather than replacing the list.
Done when new and preserved provisions are distinguishable in the draft.
verify: Compare the draft provision list to the prior issued ROR.
Pass when no previously reserved provision has been dropped without a logged reason.

steps.title: Include the general reservation and non-waiver statement
sop: Confirm the draft reserves rights not yet known or identified.
Confirm the statement that no act of investigation waives any policy right is present.
Done when both statements are confirmed present.
verify: Read the draft for the general reservation and non waiver wording.
Pass when both statements appear and neither is qualified away.

steps.title: Save the versioned draft and link it to the question list
sop: Save the draft with a version number against the claim in ClaimCenter.
Record on each open question row the draft version that reserves it.
Done when the draft is versioned and every question row is linked.
verify: Follow the link from a question row to the draft provision.
Pass when each open question resolves to a cited provision in the saved draft.

generic.Defined scope/population: All unresolved coverage questions on the claim including conditions and limits questions.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the coverage analysis to the ROR issue date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Provision, factual issue, evidence needed and target resolution date are populated per question.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Questions catalogued equal questions reserved in the ROR plus questions marked not requiring reservation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The question list is retained as a dated version on the claim before the ROR is drafted.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Questions requiring counsel are flagged separately with the referral raised.
generic.Test population: All claims with an open coverage question list created during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any question lacks a provision, evidence needed or target date.
generic.Exception handling path: Questions the handler cannot resolve are routed to coverage counsel before the position is set.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The list exists on the claim with provision, evidence needed and target date per question.
generic.Evidence location: Open coverage question list on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Create one row per unresolved coverage question
sop: Create a row carrying the provision cited, factual issue, evidence needed and target resolution date.
Draw the questions from the exclusion analysis and the insuring agreement mapping.
Done when each unresolved question exists as its own row.
verify: Compare the row count to the fact dependent determinations in the analysis.
Pass when every fact dependent determination appears as a question row.

steps.title: Add late notice and cooperation condition questions
sop: Test the notice timing against the duties after loss condition and record any doubt as a question.
Record a cooperation question where the insured has not engaged with requests.
Done when notice and cooperation are each assessed and recorded.
verify: Check the list for notice and cooperation rows or an explicit not applicable entry.
Pass when both conditions are addressed rather than omitted.

steps.title: Add limits, sublimit and other insurance questions
sop: Record questions that would reduce rather than bar coverage such as sublimit application.
Record any other insurance question where another policy may respond.
Done when reduction questions are on the list alongside bar questions.
verify: Read the list for reduction type questions.
Pass when limits and other insurance issues appear where the file shows them.

steps.title: Flag questions requiring coverage counsel separately
sop: Mark each row as handler resolvable or requiring counsel input.
Raise the counsel referral for the rows marked as requiring counsel.
Done when every row carries a resolution route and referrals are raised.
verify: Compare rows flagged for counsel to open counsel referrals.
Pass when each counsel flagged row has a matching referral.

steps.title: Set target resolution dates and evidence owners
sop: Set a target resolution date for each row driven by the evidence needed.
Name the owner responsible for obtaining that evidence.
Done when every row has a target date and an owner.
verify: Check rows for populated target dates and owners.
Pass when no row has a blank target date or owner.

steps.title: Reconcile the list to the ROR draft
sop: Mark each row as reserved in the ROR draft or expressly not requiring reservation with a reason.
Record the reconciliation date on the list.
Done when every row carries a reservation disposition.
verify: Compare rows marked reserved to provisions cited in the draft.
Pass when every reserved row appears in the draft and no row is left undispositioned.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved final ROR letter and every insured entitled to receive it on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the date the coverage question was identified to the jurisdictional issue deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Issue date, version issued, recipient list, despatch method and tracking reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entitled recipients equal addressees despatched with a tracking reference each where required.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued version and despatch proof retained on the claim with the issue date stamped.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late issue or undeliverable despatch is logged with the reason and remediation.
generic.Test population: All ROR letters issued on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the issue date is after the calculated deadline or the version sent is not the approved one.
generic.Exception handling path: A deadline at risk is escalated to the manager before it lapses rather than after.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Issue date, recipient list and despatch proof are recorded inside the required timeframe.
generic.Evidence location: Correspondence log on the claim in ClaimCenter and the claim file document repository.

steps.title: Calculate the jurisdictional ROR issue deadline
sop: Take the date the coverage question was identified from the question list.
Apply the jurisdiction issue rule to calculate the deadline and record it on the claim.
Confirm today falls inside the deadline before proceeding.
Done when the deadline is recorded and the in-window check is made.
verify: Recount the days from question identification to the recorded deadline.
Pass when the recorded deadline follows the jurisdiction rule.

steps.title: Confirm the approved final version is the one being sent
sop: Read the review approval record and note the version number approved.
Compare that version number to the document about to be despatched.
Done when the versions match and the check is recorded.
verify: Compare the despatched document ID to the approved version.
Pass when the despatched document is the approved version.

steps.title: Build the recipient list including defence counsel
sop: List every named insured, additional insured and any party tendering the claim.
Add assigned defence counsel where defence has been appointed.
Use the address of record for each recipient.
Done when the recipient list is complete with addresses.
verify: Compare the recipient list to the claim party list and defence assignment.
Pass when no entitled recipient is omitted.

steps.title: Despatch by tracked mail and save the receipts
sop: Despatch by tracked or certified mail where the jurisdiction or file requires it.
Save the tracking number and return receipt for each recipient to the claim file.
Done when all recipients are despatched with receipts saved.
verify: Compare saved receipts to the recipient list.
Pass when each recipient requiring tracked despatch has a receipt.

steps.title: Stamp the ROR issue date on the claim
sop: Record the issue date, version and despatch method on the ROR panel in ClaimCenter.
Attach the issued PDF to the coverage log issued entry.
Done when issue date, version and document are recorded.
verify: Compare the stamped issue date to the calculated deadline.
Pass when the issue date falls on or before the deadline.

steps.title: Close the ROR-due diary and open the reassessment diary
sop: Close the ROR due diary citing the issue date.
Open the reassessment diary for the reserved questions with a named owner.
Done when the due diary is closed and the reassessment diary is open.
verify: List open diaries on the claim after issue.
Pass when the due diary is closed and a reassessment diary with an owner exists.

generic.Defined scope/population: ROR drafts awaiting supervisory or coverage counsel review before issue.
generic.In-scope period: From draft submission into the review workflow to the Approved to Issue status.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reviewer identity, review timestamp, authority band and comment status are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: ROR letters issued equal ROR drafts carrying a completed approval record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval record retained against the specific draft version reviewed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reviewer comments are logged and each closed before the draft can be approved.
generic.Test population: All ROR approvals recorded on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the approval timestamp is after the issue date or the reviewer band is below the exposure band.
generic.Exception handling path: Drafts that read as a determination are returned to the drafter rather than approved with comments.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An approval record naming the reviewer and time exists and predates the ROR issue date.
generic.Evidence location: Review workflow record on the claim in ClaimCenter with counsel input in the legal matter system.

steps.title: Route the draft through the ClaimCenter review workflow
sop: Submit the versioned draft into the coverage correspondence review workflow.
Confirm the workflow captures reviewer identity and timestamp automatically.
Done when the draft sits in the review queue with a workflow record open.
verify: Open the workflow record for the draft.
Pass when the record names the draft version and is awaiting a reviewer.

steps.title: Confirm reviewer authority matches the exposure band
sop: Compare the claim exposure to the review authority bands for this line.
Escalate to the higher band where the file is large loss or policy limits exposed.
Done when a reviewer within the correct band holds the item.
verify: Compare the reviewer band to the exposure value.
Pass when the reviewer authority covers the exposure.

steps.title: Verify each cited provision exists as endorsed and is quoted accurately
sop: Open the policy documents and check each quoted provision word for word.
Confirm the form number and edition date beside each quotation are correct.
Record any inaccuracy as a workflow comment rather than editing silently.
Done when every citation is checked and discrepancies are commented.
verify: Re-check two random quotations against the forms.
Pass when both match the policy as endorsed.

steps.title: Confirm the letter reserves rather than determines coverage
sop: Read the draft for wording that could be read as a coverage decision or denial.
Comment on any sentence that states a conclusion rather than a reservation.
Done when the reservation wording review is complete and commented.
verify: Read the draft as a policyholder would for determination wording.
Pass when no sentence reads as a coverage determination.

steps.title: Resolve and close every reviewer comment
sop: Address each workflow comment with an amendment or a recorded response.
Resubmit the amended version rather than editing the reviewed version in place.
Done when no open comment remains in the workflow.
verify: List open comments on the workflow record.
Pass when the comment count is zero before approval.

steps.title: Mark the draft Approved to Issue with reviewer identity and timestamp
sop: Set the workflow status to Approved to Issue against the final version.
Confirm the record captures the reviewer identity and the approval timestamp.
Done when the approval record is complete against the final version.
verify: Compare the approval timestamp to the later ROR issue date.
Pass when the approval predates issue and names the approving reviewer.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every unresolved coverage question and every condition deadline needing a diary on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the ROR issue date to resolution or withdrawal of each reserved question.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Diary title, due date, owner and linked evidence item are populated per diary.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open coverage questions equal open diaries with one diary per question.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Diary records retained in ClaimCenter with creation date and owner history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lapsed diaries are logged and reassigned rather than closed without action.
generic.Test population: All claims with reserved coverage questions during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any unresolved question has no diary or a diary has no named owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Diaries that lapse escalate to the manager for reassignment before the next reassessment date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An open diary exists per unresolved coverage question with a due date and named owner.
generic.Evidence location: Diary list on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Create one diary per open coverage question
sop: Create a separate diary for each reserved question rather than one generic file diary.
Title each diary with the provision reserved so the subject is visible on the diary report.
Done when every open question has its own titled diary.
verify: Compare the open question count to the diary count.
Pass when the counts agree with one diary per question.

steps.title: Set the first reassessment interval
sop: Take the jurisdiction status update requirement and compare it to 30 days.
Set the first reassessment date at the shorter of the two.
Done when each diary carries a first reassessment date.
verify: Compare each diary due date to the shorter interval.
Pass when no diary is set beyond the shorter of the two intervals.

steps.title: Link each diary to the outstanding evidence item
sop: Record on each diary the evidence outstanding such as an examination, expert report or records request.
Link the diary to the activity tracking that evidence so receipt closes it cleanly.
Done when every diary names its outstanding evidence.
verify: Open each diary and read its evidence link.
Pass when each diary can be closed by receipt of a named item.

steps.title: Set separate diaries for suit-limitation and contractual deadlines
sop: Take the suit limitation and other contractual deadlines from the conditions review.
Create a distinct diary for each with a lead time before the deadline falls.
Done when each hard deadline carries its own diary.
verify: Compare recorded condition deadlines to open diaries.
Pass when every hard deadline has a diary set before it falls.

steps.title: Assign diary ownership to the current handler
sop: Set the owner on each diary to the handler currently assigned to the claim.
Confirm the diary reassignment rule applies on file transfer.
Done when every diary shows a named current owner.
verify: List diaries with a blank or departed owner.
Pass when no diary is unassigned or owned by a departed handler.

steps.title: Confirm the diaries appear on the team diary report
sop: Run the team diary report and locate this claim entries.
Correct any diary that does not surface on the report.
Done when all claim diaries appear on the report.
verify: Count claim diaries against report entries for the claim.
Pass when every open diary appears on the team report.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims with an ROR issued and no withdrawal or supplement recorded as at the extract date.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period covered by the market conduct extract with an as-at date stated.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Jurisdiction, line, issue date, ageing days and reassessment diary status are populated per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report rows equal claims flagged ROR issued minus claims with withdrawal or supplement entries.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated extract retained in the compliance pack with the as-at date and extraction evidence.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reconciliation differences and aged RORs are logged with the handler action taken.
generic.Test population: All open ROR extracts produced during the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the extract does not reconcile to the claim system ROR flags or carries no as-at date.
generic.Exception handling path: Aged or diary lapsed RORs route to the handler for reassessment or withdrawal.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated open-ROR extract sits in the compliance pack and reconciles to the claim system flags.
generic.Evidence location: Market conduct reporting pack in the GRC platform with the source extract from ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Run the open-ROR report filtered by jurisdiction and line
sop: Run the open ROR report in ClaimCenter with the as-at date set to the reporting date.
Filter by jurisdiction and line of business as the compliance pack requires.
Done when the extract is produced with its as-at date recorded.
verify: Check the extract header for the as-at date and filters used.
Pass when the as-at date and filters are stated on the extract.

steps.title: Confirm each open item still has an unresolved coverage question
sop: For each row, check the open coverage question list on the claim.
Mark rows where all questions are resolved for withdrawal action.
Done when every row is confirmed still open or marked for withdrawal.
verify: Sample rows and compare to the claim question lists.
Pass when sampled rows match the claim question status.

steps.title: Reconcile the report count to the ROR flags in ClaimCenter
sop: Count claims flagged ROR issued with no withdrawal or supplement entry.
Compare that count to the report row count and investigate any difference.
Record the reconciliation and any adjustments made.
Done when the counts agree or the difference is explained.
verify: Read the reconciliation working for unexplained differences.
Pass when the report ties to the ROR flag count or the variance is documented.

steps.title: Flag RORs open beyond the jurisdiction ageing threshold
sop: Compute days open from the issue date for each row.
Flag rows beyond the ageing threshold for the jurisdiction and route them to the handler.
Done when every aged row carries a routing action.
verify: List aged rows against routing actions raised.
Pass when each aged row has an action assigned to a named handler.

steps.title: Confirm each open ROR has an active reassessment diary
sop: Check the claim diary list for an open reassessment diary on each row.
Escalate rows with a lapsed or missing diary to the manager.
Done when every row has a confirmed diary or an escalation.
verify: Cross check report rows against open diaries.
Pass when no row lacks either a diary or an escalation.

steps.title: Publish the extract into the market conduct pack in the GRC platform
sop: Upload the extract to the market conduct reporting pack with the as-at date in the file name.
Attach the extraction evidence showing the query and filters used.
Done when the extract and evidence are published in the pack.
verify: Open the pack entry and check the as-at date and evidence.
Pass when the published extract carries an as-at date and reproducible extraction evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every provision reserved in the issued ROR tested against the closed investigation findings.
generic.In-scope period: From closure of the investigation on a reserved question to issue of the withdrawal or supplement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Provision, resolution outcome, ROR status value and recipient list are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reserved provisions equal provisions marked resolved plus provisions still open.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Withdrawal or supplement letter version retained with its issue date on the coverage log.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Provisions resolved against the insured are logged and carried into the coverage position.
generic.Test population: All claims where the ROR status changed to Withdrawn or Supplemented during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any coverage question remains open once the ROR status is set to Withdrawn.
generic.Exception handling path: New issues emerging during resolution are added by supplement rather than by re-issuing the ROR.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No coverage question remains flagged open once ROR status is set to Withdrawn.
generic.Evidence location: ROR status panel and coverage log on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Test each reserved provision against the closed findings
sop: Take each reserved provision and read the investigation findings that bear on it.
Mark it resolved in favour, resolved against or still open.
Done when every reserved provision carries a resolution mark.
verify: Compare marks to the findings cited for each provision.
Pass when every mark is supported by a named finding.

steps.title: Issue a withdrawal letter where all reservations resolve in favour
sop: Draft a letter stating the reservations are withdrawn and coverage is confirmed.
Name each provision being withdrawn so the insured can match it to the original ROR.
Done when the withdrawal letter is drafted and reviewed.
verify: Compare withdrawn provisions to the provisions in the issued ROR.
Pass when every originally reserved provision is addressed in the withdrawal.

steps.title: Issue a supplemental ROR where a new issue has emerged
sop: Draft a supplement adding only the newly identified provisions.
State expressly that the prior reservations are maintained.
Done when the supplement adds new provisions and preserves the prior ones.
verify: Compare the supplement provision list to the original ROR list.
Pass when no prior reservation is dropped and each addition is new.

steps.title: Send to the identical recipient list used for the original ROR
sop: Retrieve the recipient list recorded on the original ROR issued log entry.
Send the withdrawal or supplement to the same parties including defence counsel.
Done when the despatch covers the original recipient list.
verify: Compare the new despatch recipients to the original list.
Pass when the two lists match or additions are explained.

steps.title: Update the ROR status field in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the ROR status to Withdrawn or Supplemented with the issue date of the new letter.
Attach the issued letter to the coverage log entry for the status change.
Done when the status, date and document are recorded.
verify: Read the status panel and its attached document.
Pass when the status matches the letter issued and carries its date.

steps.title: Close resolved question rows and their diaries
sop: Close each open coverage question row that the resolution disposes of.
Close the linked reassessment diary citing the resolution outcome.
Done when resolved rows and their diaries are closed.
verify: List open question rows and diaries after the status change.
Pass when a Withdrawn status leaves no open coverage question row on the claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every policy layer on risk for this loss from primary through excess and umbrella.
generic.In-scope period: Layers in force at the date of loss with their terms as endorsed at that date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Carrier, policy number, attachment point, limit and follow-form status are populated per layer.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of layer limits plus the retention equals the total programme limit recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Layer schedule retained on the claim with each layer declarations page and capture date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers with unavailable wordings are logged with the request raised to obtain them.
generic.Test population: All multi-layer claims where a layer schedule was built during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any layer lacks an attachment point or the exhaustion basis is not stated.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous exhaustion wording routes to coverage counsel before any payment order is acted on.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A layer schedule with attachment points, limits and exhaustion basis is recorded on the claim.
generic.Evidence location: Layer schedule note in the coverage section of the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Build the layer schedule from the programme documents
sop: List each layer with carrier, policy number, attachment point and limit from the declarations held.
Record whether each layer is follow form or has standalone wording.
Done when every known layer appears on the schedule with these fields.
verify: Compare the schedule to the programme summary and declarations retrieved.
Pass when every layer on the programme appears with an attachment point and limit.

steps.title: Read the other insurance and maintenance of underlying clauses
sop: Open each excess and umbrella wording and read the other insurance clause.
Read the maintenance of underlying insurance condition and record what must remain in force.
Done when the attachment conditions for each layer are recorded.
verify: Compare recorded conditions to the wording quoted for each layer.
Pass when each recorded condition is supported by quoted wording.

steps.title: Determine whether exhaustion requires actual payment
sop: Read the exhaustion wording in each excess layer and record whether payment of underlying limits is required.
Record whether exhaustion by settlement or erosion is permitted.
Done when the exhaustion basis for each layer is stated.
verify: Compare the stated basis to the exhaustion clause quoted.
Pass when the basis stated follows from the clause quoted.

steps.title: Record whether defence costs sit inside or outside each limit
sop: Read each layer defence cost provision and record inside or outside the limit.
Adjust the attachment arithmetic where defence costs erode an underlying limit.
Done when defence cost treatment is recorded for every layer.
verify: Recompute attachment using the recorded defence treatment.
Pass when the attachment arithmetic reflects the recorded treatment.

steps.title: Record the resulting payment order
sop: State the order in which layers respond given the attachment points and exhaustion basis.
Record the incurred value at which each subsequent layer attaches.
Done when the payment order and attachment triggers are recorded.
verify: Test the payment order against the current incurred value.
Pass when the layer identified as responding matches the incurred position.

steps.title: Set the notice trigger for the next layer in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the incurred threshold at which the next layer must be put on notice.
Open a diary that fires when incurred value approaches that threshold.
Done when the notice trigger and diary are set.
verify: Compare the diary threshold to the recorded attachment point.
Pass when the diary fires before the next layer attaches.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every other carrier on risk for this loss and the contribution issues between them.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the other carriers to written confirmation of the agreed arrangements.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Carrier name, adjuster name, claim number, contact detail and stated position are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Carriers identified on risk equal carriers recorded on the claim with a stated position.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Exchanged declarations and written confirmations filed with dates against the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Carriers refusing to engage are logged with the escalation route taken.
generic.Test population: All multi-carrier claims coordinated during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any participating carrier has no recorded contact detail or stated position.
generic.Exception handling path: Deadlocked coordination escalates to coverage counsel rather than continuing informally.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The claim records each carrier with contacts, stated position and dated written confirmation of agreements.
generic.Evidence location: Multi-carrier coordination note and correspondence on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Identify the other carriers on risk and record their contacts
sop: Identify other carriers from the contracts, suit papers and insured disclosures.
Record adjuster name, carrier claim number and contact details for each.
Done when every identified carrier has a contact record on the claim.
verify: Compare carriers named in the file to carriers recorded.
Pass when no carrier named in the file is missing a contact record.

steps.title: Exchange declarations pages and other insurance clauses
sop: Request each carrier declarations page and other insurance clause in writing.
Provide the corresponding documents for our policy on the same basis.
File the exchanged documents to the claim with the exchange date.
Done when the exchange is complete or the non responding carriers are logged.
verify: List exchanged documents against the carrier list.
Pass when each engaged carrier has provided or been chased for its documents.

steps.title: Establish primary, excess and pro-rata standing
sop: Compare the other insurance clauses to determine which policies are primary and which excess.
Record the resulting standing for each carrier with the clause relied on.
Done when standing is recorded for every carrier.
verify: Read each standing conclusion against the clause quoted.
Pass when each conclusion is supported by the quoted clause.

steps.title: Agree in writing which carrier controls investigation and defence
sop: Agree the controlling carrier for investigation, defence and expert instruction.
Confirm the arrangement in writing to all participating carriers.
Done when the control arrangement is confirmed in writing to all carriers.
verify: Check for duplicate expert instructions after the agreement date.
Pass when only the controlling carrier instructs experts after the agreement.

steps.title: Record each carrier contribution position and its basis
sop: Record each carrier position as accepted, disputed or reserved.
Record the basis the carrier gives for its position.
Done when every carrier position and basis are recorded.
verify: Compare recorded positions to the carrier correspondence held.
Pass when each recorded position is supported by carrier correspondence.

steps.title: Confirm call outcomes in writing and file the correspondence
sop: After each call, issue a written confirmation of what was agreed and by whom.
File the outbound confirmation to the claim correspondence log with its date.
Done when every call agreement has a filed written confirmation.
verify: Compare call notes to filed written confirmations.
Pass when every agreement reached on a call has a dated written confirmation.

generic.Defined scope/population: The indemnity and defence cost allocation between all contributing carriers on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From agreement or reservation of the allocation basis to closure of the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Allocation basis, per carrier indemnity share, defence share and disputed amount are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Allocation percentages total 100 percent and tie to the exposure reserves on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed sharing or interim funding agreement attached with its execution date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputed shares are logged with the amount at risk if the disputing carrier does not fund.
generic.Test population: All claims with a recorded multi-carrier allocation during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the allocation does not total 100 percent or the methodology is not stated.
generic.Exception handling path: Allocation without agreement is recorded under reservation rather than presented as agreed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The allocation note states the methodology and per-carrier indemnity and defence shares totalling 100 percent.
generic.Evidence location: Allocation note and attached agreement in the coverage section of the claim.

steps.title: Record the allocation basis selected and why
sop: Record the basis as equal shares, limits based, time on risk or by agreement.
State in one sentence why that basis was selected for this loss.
Done when the basis and its rationale are recorded.
verify: Read the rationale against the policy wordings and the loss facts.
Pass when the basis chosen is explained rather than assumed.

steps.title: Record indemnity and defence shares separately per carrier
sop: Record each carrier indemnity share as a percentage.
Record each carrier defence cost share separately since it is often allocated differently.
Done when both share sets are recorded for every carrier.
verify: Check that indemnity and defence shares are held as distinct values.
Pass when the two are recorded separately for each carrier.

steps.title: Attach the sharing or interim funding agreement
sop: Attach the executed sharing or interim funding agreement to the claim file.
Where no agreement exists, record expressly that allocation is under reservation pending agreement.
Done when an agreement is attached or the reservation is recorded.
verify: Check the claim for either an executed agreement or a reservation statement.
Pass when one of the two is present and dated.

steps.title: Reconcile the allocation to 100 percent
sop: Sum the indemnity shares and the defence shares independently.
Correct any set that does not total 100 percent before saving.
Done when both share sets total 100 percent.
verify: Recompute both totals from the recorded shares.
Pass when both totals equal 100 percent.

steps.title: Reconcile the allocation to the exposure reserves
sop: Apply our share to the gross exposure and compare to the reserve set on the claim.
Adjust the reserve or record the reason for the difference.
Done when reserve and share are reconciled.
verify: Recompute our share value against the reserve held.
Pass when the reserve equals our share of gross or the difference is explained.

steps.title: Note disputed shares and the amount at risk
sop: List each disputed share with the carrier disputing it.
Record the amount our claim carries if the disputing carrier does not fund.
Done when every dispute has a quantified exposure recorded.
verify: Sum the disputed amounts and compare to the recorded exposure at risk.
Pass when the amount at risk equals the sum of unfunded disputed shares.

generic.Defined scope/population: Multi-carrier coverage disputes on this claim that could not be resolved between adjusters.
generic.In-scope period: From the escalation trigger being met to receipt of the counsel response.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger met, matter number, referral date, response deadline and legal reserve are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalation triggers recorded equal matters opened plus triggers explicitly not escalated with a reason.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral package retained on the matter with a manifest and transfer date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals declined or reassigned by counsel are logged with the next action.
generic.Test population: All multi-carrier disputes escalated during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if no matter exists in the legal matter system linked to the claim number.
generic.Exception handling path: Legal spend above the handler authority is escalated before the matter is instructed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A coverage dispute matter exists in the legal matter management system linked to this claim.
generic.Evidence location: Matter record in the legal matter management system with the referral note on the claim.

steps.title: Confirm the escalation trigger is met
sop: Test the file against the triggers of contribution refused, allocation deadlocked or declaratory action threatened.
Record which trigger is met and the evidence for it.
Done when the trigger and its evidence are recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the recorded trigger against the correspondence held.
Pass when the trigger is supported by file evidence.

steps.title: Open the coverage dispute matter in the legal matter system
sop: Open a matter linked to the claim number with the matter type set to coverage dispute.
Record the jurisdiction and the exposure on the matter header.
Done when the matter exists with claim number, type and exposure recorded.
verify: Search the matter system by claim number.
Pass when the search returns a coverage dispute matter for this claim.

steps.title: Package the referral with the layer schedule and carrier positions
sop: Assemble the layer schedule, all carrier declarations pages and their coverage positions.
Add the full correspondence trail between the carriers.
Record a manifest of the package contents on the matter.
Done when the package and manifest are delivered to the matter.
verify: Compare the manifest to the documents attached to the matter.
Pass when every manifest item is present on the matter.

steps.title: Set the reserve for coverage dispute legal spend
sop: Estimate the legal spend on the dispute and set the expense reserve.
Compare the reserve to the handler authority and escalate where it exceeds it.
Done when the reserve is set and the authority check is recorded.
verify: Compare the reserve value to the recorded authority band.
Pass when the reserve is within authority or an approval is recorded.

steps.title: Obtain manager approval for the escalation
sop: Review the trigger, package and reserve before the referral is instructed.
Record approval or the changes required on the claim.
Done when the manager decision is recorded.
verify: Compare the approval date to the referral instruction date.
Pass when approval predates instruction.

steps.title: Record the referral date and diary the counsel response
sop: Record the referral date and the response deadline on the claim.
Set a diary for the response deadline with a named owner.
Done when the dates are recorded and the diary is open.
verify: Check the claim for the referral date and an open diary.
Pass when both exist and the diary due date matches the response deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every party asserting coverage under this policy and the scope owed to each.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term in force at the date of loss including endorsements effective before it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Party, coverage route, defence owed, indemnity owed and limitations are populated per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parties on the tender list equal rows on the per-party coverage grid.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Grid retained with the endorsement form numbers and contract versions relied on.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties owed nothing are recorded with the reason rather than removed from the grid.
generic.Test population: All multi-party claims with a coverage grid built during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any asserting party has no defence and indemnity determination on the grid.
generic.Exception handling path: Blanket additional insured wording without a written contract routes to counsel before determination.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The per-party grid states defence and indemnity owed for each party asserting coverage.
generic.Evidence location: Per-party coverage grid in the coverage section of the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Identify each party route to coverage
sop: For each asserting party, identify the route as named insured, scheduled AI, blanket AI or permissive user.
Record the endorsement form number and edition supporting the route.
Done when every party has a recorded coverage route.
verify: Compare each route to the endorsement cited.
Pass when every route is supported by a cited endorsement or policy definition.

steps.title: Obtain the underlying written contract for blanket AI wording
sop: Request the written contract from the insured where the route is blanket additional insured.
Confirm the contract predates the loss and requires the party to be added as an insured.
Done when the contract is obtained and the pre-loss requirement is confirmed.
verify: Compare the contract execution date to the date of loss.
Pass when the AI obligation existed before the loss or the shortfall is recorded.

steps.title: Determine defence and indemnity owed per party
sop: For each party, decide whether defence, indemnity or both are owed.
Record whether coverage is limited to vicarious liability arising from the named insured operations.
Done when every party has both determinations recorded.
verify: Read each determination against the endorsement wording quoted.
Pass when both determinations exist for every party and follow the wording.

steps.title: Check separation of insureds and cross-liability wording
sop: Read the separation of insureds condition where one insured conduct triggers an exclusion.
Record whether the exclusion applies to all insureds or only the one whose conduct triggered it.
Done when the separation analysis is recorded for the affected parties.
verify: Compare the recorded effect to the condition wording quoted.
Pass when the effect stated follows from the quoted condition.

steps.title: Record limitations applying to each party
sop: Record limits shared or dedicated per party and any sublimit that applies to that party only.
Record any coverage limited to ongoing operations or excluding completed operations.
Done when limitations are recorded for every party.
verify: Compare recorded limitations to the endorsement text.
Pass when each limitation cites the wording that creates it.

steps.title: Save the per-party coverage grid to the claim
sop: Record the grid with columns for party, route, defence owed, indemnity owed and limitations.
Date the grid and cite the endorsements and contracts relied on.
Done when the completed grid is saved to the coverage section.
verify: Compare grid rows to the tendering party list.
Pass when every asserting party has a completed grid row.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every party that has tendered on this claim plus parties entitled to tender who have not.
generic.In-scope period: From first tender received to the date the party list is finalised for the coverage grid.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Party name, tender date, tendering document and coverage asserted are populated per party.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tender documents on the claim equal tendering parties recorded on the party list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each tendering document retained with its receipt date stamped on the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties with disputed standing are flagged with the reason rather than omitted.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any tender document has no corresponding party on the claim party list.
generic.Exception handling path: Latent tenders identified from contracts are recorded as potential exposure and monitored.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The party list includes every tendering party with tender date and asserting document recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Claim party list and tender documents in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: List every party that has tendered on the claim

List each tendering party with the entity name used in the tender.
Done when every tender in the correspondence is listed.
verify: Count tender documents against listed parties.

steps.title: Record tender date, document and coverage asserted

Record which document constitutes the tender and what coverage it asserts.
Done when all three fields are recorded per party.
verify: Open a sample of tenders and compare to recorded fields.
Pass when the recorded date and asserted coverage match the document.

steps.title: Check suit papers and contracts for parties entitled to tender
sop: Read the suit papers and the underlying contracts for indemnitees and additional insureds.
List parties entitled to tender who have not yet done so as latent exposure.
Done when the latent tender list is recorded.
verify: Compare contract indemnity clauses to the latent list.
Pass when every contractual indemnitee appears as tendered or latent.

steps.title: Add each tendering party to the claim party list with the correct role
sop: Add each party in ClaimCenter with the role that matches its asserted status.
Record the address of record so letters reach the party.
Done when every tendering party exists on the claim with a role and address.
verify: Compare the tender list to the claim party list.
Pass when the two lists agree with a role on every party.

steps.title: Flag parties whose standing is disputed
sop: Mark parties whose entitlement is contested as standing disputed with the reason.
Keep them on the party list rather than removing them.
Done when every disputed party is flagged with a reason.
verify: List disputed parties and check each has a recorded reason.
Pass when no disputed party is missing from the list or its reason.

steps.title: Confirm the list feeds the correspondence recipients
sop: Check that coverage correspondence templates draw recipients from the party list.
Correct any party excluded from correspondence by an incorrect role.
Done when all tendering parties would receive coverage correspondence.
verify: Generate a recipient preview from a coverage template.
Pass when every tendering party appears in the preview.

generic.Defined scope/population: The defence and indemnity sharing terms negotiated with the other carriers on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From authority approval before the first negotiation call to execution of the agreement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approved share range, walk-away share, defence terms, indemnity terms and execution date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Agreed shares across all signatory carriers total 100 percent of defence and of indemnity.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed agreement retained against the claim with its execution date and signatory list.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Terms conceded outside the approved range are logged with the approval that permitted them.
generic.Test population: All coverage-sharing agreements negotiated during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the executed agreement lacks a reservation of rights or a reallocation clause.
generic.Exception handling path: Deadlock beyond the approved range routes to counsel rather than being settled informally.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An executed agreement with reservation-of-rights and reallocation clauses is filed against the claim.
generic.Evidence location: Executed agreement on the claim in ClaimCenter and the matter in the legal matter system.

steps.title: Obtain approval for the negotiating position and walk-away share
sop: Review the proposed opening share, target share and walk away share for defence and indemnity.
Record the approved range on the claim before the first call takes place.
Done when the approved range is recorded and dated.
verify: Compare the approval date to the first negotiation contact date.
Pass when the approval predates the first call.

steps.title: Negotiate defence-cost sharing as a separate term
sop: Negotiate the defence cost share independently of indemnity.
Record the agreed defence percentage and the basis given for it.
Done when the defence share is agreed or the deadlock is recorded.
verify: Check the draft for a distinct defence sharing clause.
Pass when defence sharing appears as its own term with its own percentage.

steps.title: Negotiate indemnity sharing as a separate term
sop: Negotiate the indemnity share against the layer and limits position established earlier.
Record the agreed indemnity percentage and the basis given.
Done when the indemnity share is agreed or the deadlock is recorded.
verify: Compare the agreed share to the approved range.
Pass when the agreed share is inside the approved range or carries a recorded approval.

steps.title: Ensure the draft reserves coverage rights and includes non-waiver
sop: Confirm the agreement states participation does not concede coverage.
Confirm a non waiver clause covers all policy rights and defences.
Done when both clauses are confirmed present in the draft.
verify: Read the draft for the reservation and non waiver clauses.
Pass when both appear and neither is qualified away elsewhere in the draft.

steps.title: Include reallocation and dispute-resolution mechanisms
sop: Add a true up mechanism allowing shares to be reallocated as facts develop.
Add a dispute resolution route for later disagreement over shares.
Done when both mechanisms appear in the draft.
verify: Read the draft for the true up and dispute clauses.
Pass when both mechanisms are present and operable.

steps.title: Route through counsel review and file the executed copy
sop: Send the agreed draft for counsel review and resolve every comment before signature.
File the executed copy against the claim with its execution date and signatories.
Done when the executed agreement is filed on the claim.
verify: Open the filed agreement and check signatures and clauses.
Pass when the executed copy carries all signatories, the reservation and the reallocation clause.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every tender of defence received from another carrier or party on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the date each tender is received to the calculated response deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt date, deadline, response type, policy basis and despatch date are populated per tender.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tenders received equal tenders with a recorded substantive response or an open in-window item.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgment and substantive response retained with despatch dates against each tender.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late responses are logged with the cause and the remediation recorded.
generic.Test population: All defence tenders received on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any tender has no dated written response on or before its calculated deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Tenders needing more information get an acknowledgment and an information request inside the window.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each tender carries a dated written response recorded on or before its deadline.
generic.Evidence location: Tender records and correspondence log on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Date-stamp the tender and calculate the response deadline
sop: Record the tender receipt date on the claim on the day it arrives.
Apply the jurisdiction tender response rule or the contract stated period to calculate the deadline.
Done when receipt date and deadline are recorded.
verify: Recount the days from receipt to the recorded deadline.
Pass when the deadline follows the applicable rule.

steps.title: Send a written acknowledgment and request the underlying documents
sop: Send an acknowledgment stating coverage is under review.
Request the underlying written contract and the suit papers in the same letter.
Done when the acknowledgment is despatched and recorded.
verify: Compare the acknowledgment despatch date to the receipt date.
Pass when the acknowledgment was sent promptly after receipt.

steps.title: Determine the substantive response type
sop: Decide whether to accept, accept under reservation or decline the tender.
State the policy basis for the decision with form number and clause.
Done when the response type and policy basis are recorded.
verify: Read the basis against the endorsement or clause cited.
Pass when the response type is supported by the cited wording.

steps.title: State the defence terms where accepting under reservation
sop: State whether defence is accepted and whether the insured may select counsel.
State how defence costs will be treated and whether they erode the limit.
Done when the defence terms appear in the response.
verify: Read the response for defence, counsel selection and cost treatment.
Pass when all three points are addressed explicitly.

steps.title: Issue the substantive response and record despatch
sop: Despatch the response to the tendering party by a recorded method.
Record the despatch date and method against the tender record.
Done when the response is despatched and recorded.
verify: Compare the despatch date to the calculated deadline.
Pass when the response was despatched on or before the deadline.

steps.title: Diary the deadline so no tender lapses unnoticed
sop: Set a diary at the response deadline for each open tender with a named owner.
Close the diary only when the substantive response is despatched.
Done when every open tender has a diary and closed tenders have none.
verify: List open tenders against open diaries.
Pass when every open tender has a diary due on or before its deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every policy provision relied on for denial and the evidence establishing the facts it depends on.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the investigation on each ground to finalisation of the denial basis memo.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Provision, fact relied on, document ID and investigation status are populated per ground.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Factual assertions in the memo equal assertions carrying a claim file document ID.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each cited document indexed in the claim file with an ID and upload timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Evidence cutting against the denial is logged with the explanation of why it does not change the outcome.
generic.Test population: All denial basis memos prepared on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any factual assertion in the memo has no document ID behind it.
generic.Exception handling path: Grounds resting on an unclosed line of enquiry are removed or the enquiry is completed first.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The memo cites a claim file document ID for every factual assertion relied on.
generic.Evidence location: Denial basis memo on the claim in ClaimCenter with documents in OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: Pair each policy provision with the evidence establishing its facts
sop: List each provision relied on with the fact it requires.
Name the specific document that establishes that fact for each provision.
Done when every provision has a fact and a named document.
verify: Read each pairing and check the document supports the stated fact.
Pass when no provision relies on an unevidenced fact.

steps.title: Confirm each cited document is indexed with a document ID
sop: Locate each cited statement, report, photograph or invoice in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Record its document ID in the memo beside the assertion it supports.
Index any cited document not yet filed before finalising the memo.
Done when every citation carries a resolvable document ID.
verify: Open three cited IDs from the memo.
Pass when each ID resolves to the document described.

steps.title: Confirm the investigation is reasonably complete for each ground
sop: For each ground, list the lines of enquiry opened and their status.
Remove or defer any ground resting on an unclosed enquiry.
Done when every retained ground rests on closed enquiries.
verify: List open investigation activities against the retained grounds.
Pass when no retained ground depends on an open activity.

steps.title: Record evidence that cuts against the denial
sop: List statements, findings or documents inconsistent with the denial grounds.
Explain for each why it does not change the conclusion.
Done when adverse evidence is listed and addressed.
verify: Read the memo for an adverse evidence section.
Pass when adverse evidence is addressed rather than omitted.

steps.title: Confirm the insured had the opportunity to provide the information relied on
sop: Check requests made to the insured such as proof of loss or records requests.
Record the request dates and whether a reasonable response window was given.
Done when the request history and response window are recorded.
verify: Compare request dates to the memo finalisation date.
Pass when the insured had a recorded opportunity before the basis was finalised.

steps.title: Finalise and file the denial basis memo
sop: Assemble the grounds, evidence, adverse evidence and request history into the memo.
File the memo to the claim in ClaimCenter with the date of finalisation.
Done when the dated memo is filed against the claim.
verify: Read the memo as an approver would before signing off a denial.
Pass when every ground can be traced to a provision and a document ID from the memo alone.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every independent ground for denial on this claim and the required consumer content for the jurisdiction.
generic.In-scope period: From finalisation of the denial basis memo to submission of the draft for approval.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Provision quoted, form number, edition date, factual basis and consumer content are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Grounds in the basis memo equal grounds stated in the draft letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft version saved to the claim file with a version number and drafting date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Grounds considered but not relied on are logged with the reason on the coverage log.
generic.Test population: All denial letters drafted on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a ground is paraphrased or the required appeal and regulator content is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: Grounds counsel disputes are removed or amended before approval rather than issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The draft quotes each ground with form number and edition date and carries required appeal and regulator content.
generic.Evidence location: Draft denial letter attached to the coverage section of the claim file.

steps.title: Quote each provision relied on with citation and facts beneath
sop: Insert the full text of each provision relied on with its form number and edition date.
Set out immediately beneath each quotation the facts that engage it.
Done when each ground appears as quotation plus engaging facts.
verify: Compare each quotation to the policy as endorsed.
Pass when every quotation matches the source form.

steps.title: State every independent ground in the same letter
sop: List all grounds from the basis memo rather than reserving grounds for later.
Confirm each is stated as independently sufficient where that is the position.
Done when every memo ground appears in the draft.
verify: Compare the memo ground list to the draft ground list.
Pass when the two lists agree.

steps.title: Insert the jurisdiction required consumer content
sop: Add the reconsideration or appeal route and any time limit on it.
Add the department of insurance contact details and prescribed notice text.
Done when all required consumer content is present.
verify: Check the draft against the jurisdiction content checklist.
Pass when no checklist item is missing.

steps.title: Rewrite the letter into plain policyholder language
sop: Remove internal jargon, claim codes and any reserve reference from the draft.
Explain each ground in language a policyholder can follow.
Done when the draft contains no internal terminology.
verify: Read the draft as a policyholder would.
Pass when no claim code, jargon or reserve figure remains.

steps.title: Check the draft against prior positions issued on the file
sop: Review the correspondence log for coverage confirmations, RORs and partial payments.
Confirm the denial does not contradict any of them without explaining the change.
Done when the consistency check is complete and recorded.
verify: Compare the draft to prior coverage correspondence.
Pass when no contradiction is left unexplained.

steps.title: Obtain counsel input and save the versioned draft
sop: Review the draft for wording, jurisdiction content and litigation risk.
Record the comments and confirm the amended version addresses them.
Save the versioned draft to the claim file for approval.
Done when the counsel reviewed version is saved.
verify: Open the saved draft and check version and counsel comment closure.
Pass when the saved version reflects the closed counsel comments.

generic.Defined scope/population: Unresolved coverage disputes on this claim meeting a formal opinion referral trigger.
generic.In-scope period: From the trigger being met to receipt of the formal coverage opinion.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger, matter number, jurisdiction, exposure, question set and deadline are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Triggers recorded equal matters opened plus triggers logged as not requiring referral.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral record retained with the question set, deadline and referral date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Litigation hold acknowledgments are logged per custodian with the date received.
generic.Test population: All coverage opinion referrals raised during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the matter carries no stated question set or no response deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Where suit is threatened, a litigation hold is issued before the referral proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A legal matter for the coverage opinion exists with a question set and response deadline.
generic.Evidence location: Matter record in the legal matter management system and the dispute log on the claim.

steps.title: Confirm the escalation trigger is met and record it
sop: Test the file for a bad faith allegation, declaratory judgment threat, regulator complaint or exposure threshold breach.
Record which trigger is met and the document evidencing it.
Done when the trigger and its evidence are recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the recorded trigger against the file evidence.
Pass when the trigger is supported by a document on the claim.

steps.title: Open the coverage opinion matter with claim, jurisdiction and exposure
sop: Open a matter in the legal matter system linked to the claim number.
Record the governing jurisdiction and the current exposure on the matter header.
Done when the matter exists with all three fields recorded.
verify: Search the matter system by claim number.
Pass when a coverage opinion matter is returned with jurisdiction and exposure.

steps.title: State the precise questions and the deadline driving them
sop: Write numbered questions that counsel can answer without a further call.
State the pleading, appeal or regulatory date driving each deadline.
Done when numbered questions and deadlines are recorded on the matter.
verify: Read the question set for answerability and deadlines.
Pass when each question is numbered and carries a deadline.

steps.title: Issue a litigation hold where suit is threatened
sop: Issue the hold over the claim file and related communications.
Identify custodians and obtain their acknowledgment.
Record the acknowledgments against the claim.
Done when the hold is issued and acknowledgments are recorded.
verify: List custodians against acknowledgments received.
Pass when every custodian has acknowledged or been chased.

steps.title: Obtain manager sign-off on the referral and legal reserve
sop: Review the trigger, questions and the legal expense reserve proposed.
Record approval or required changes before counsel is instructed.
Done when the manager decision is recorded on the claim.
verify: Compare the approval date to the instruction date.
Pass when approval predates instruction.

steps.title: Record the referral date and diary the counsel response
sop: Record the referral date in the coverage dispute log on the claim.
Diary the counsel response deadline with a named owner.
Done when the referral date and diary are recorded.
verify: Check the dispute log and diary list.
Pass when the referral date is logged and an open diary matches the deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every policyholder dispute or reconsideration request received on this claim decision.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the dispute to closure with a recorded outcome.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt date, channel, decision challenged, classification and outcome code are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disputes received equal dispute records created plus items reclassified with a reason.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Incoming dispute document retained with its receipt date against the dispute record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Independence breaches or missed clocks are logged with the remediation taken.

steps.title: Create the dispute record with receipt date and channel
sop: Create a dispute or complaint record on the claim on the day of receipt.
Record the channel as letter, call, portal, regulator or ombudsman.
Record the specific decision being challenged.
Done when the record exists with all three fields.
verify: Compare the record receipt date to the incoming document date.
Pass when the dates agree and the channel is populated.

steps.title: Classify the dispute as reconsideration or regulatory complaint
sop: Determine whether the item is an internal reconsideration or a regulatory complaint.
