Pass when a regulator sourced item is classified as a regulatory complaint.

steps.title: Assign the review to an independent handler where required
sop: Check the complaints policy for the independence requirement.
Assign the review to a handler who did not make the original decision where required.
Done when the reviewer assignment satisfies the policy.
verify: Compare the reviewer identity to the original decision maker.
Pass when the two differ where independence is required.

steps.title: Diary the acknowledgment and substantive response deadlines separately
sop: Calculate the acknowledgment deadline and the substantive response deadline for the classification.
Create a separate diary for each with a named owner.
Done when both diaries are open with due dates.
verify: List diaries on the dispute record.
Pass when two distinct diaries exist with correct due dates.

steps.title: Track the dispute through to a substantive response
sop: Work the review and record each step on the dispute record.
Close the acknowledgment diary on despatch of the acknowledgment.
Done when the substantive response is despatched and recorded.
verify: Compare the response despatch date to the response deadline.
Pass when the response was despatched on or before the deadline.

steps.title: Record the outcome with a root-cause reason code
sop: Record the outcome as upheld, partially upheld or overturned.
Select the reason code so complaint root cause reporting picks it up.
Done when outcome and reason code are recorded and the record is closed.
verify: Run the complaint root cause report and locate this dispute.
Pass when the dispute appears with its outcome and reason code.

generic.Defined scope/population: The denied exposures on this claim and the denial reason codes matching the issued letter.
generic.In-scope period: From the denial letter issue date to the daily denial report run following it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure disposition, denial reason codes, denial date and attached letter are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Grounds stated in the letter equal denial reason codes recorded on the exposure.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued letter PDF attached to the denial record with the issue date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Pending payment transactions on a denied exposure are logged and stopped with a reason.
generic.Test population: All denials logged in the claims system during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the disposition is not Denied or the issued letter is not attached.
generic.Exception handling path: Denials that do not appear on the daily denial report are escalated for data correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exposure disposition is Denied with reason codes, denial date and the issued letter attached.
generic.Evidence location: Exposure disposition panel and denial record on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Set the exposure disposition to Denied with the primary reason code
sop: Open the exposure in ClaimCenter and set the disposition to Denied.
Select the reason code matching the primary ground stated in the letter.
Done when disposition and primary reason code are saved.
verify: Compare the reason code to the letter primary ground.
Pass when the code matches the ground stated first in the letter.

steps.title: Enter the denial date as the letter issue date
sop: Read the issue date from the correspondence log entry for the denial letter.
Enter that date as the denial date rather than the decision date.
Done when the denial date matches the letter issue date.
verify: Compare the denial date to the correspondence issue date.
Pass when the two dates agree.

steps.title: Attach the issued letter PDF to the denial record
sop: Retrieve the issued version by its document ID from the claim file.
Attach that version to the denial record on the exposure.
Done when the issued PDF is attached to the denial record.
verify: Open the attachment and compare it to the despatched document ID.
Pass when the attached PDF is the version issued.

steps.title: Record each additional ground as its own reason code
sop: List the grounds stated in the letter beyond the primary one.
Record each as a separate denial reason on the exposure.
Done when every letter ground has a reason code.
verify: Count grounds in the letter against reason codes recorded.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Close or zero the reserve on the denied exposure
sop: Zero the indemnity reserve on the denied exposure.
Confirm no payment transaction remains pending against it.
Done when the reserve is zero and no pending payment exists.
verify: Read the exposure reserve and pending transaction list.
Pass when the reserve is zero and the pending list is empty.

steps.title: Confirm the denial appears on the daily denial report
sop: Run or open the daily denial report for the denial date.
Locate this claim and confirm the flag flows to the market conduct extract.
Raise a data correction where the claim is absent.
Done when the claim is confirmed on the report or a correction is raised.
verify: Search the report for the claim number.
Pass when the claim appears with its denial date and reason code.

generic.Defined scope/population: Denial drafts awaiting supervisory or legal approval before issue on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From submission into the approval workflow to the Approved to Issue status.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approver identity, timestamp, authority band and comment closure status are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Denial letters issued equal denial drafts with a completed approval record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval record retained against the exact draft version approved.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approver comments are logged and each closed before the status can change.
generic.Test population: All denial approvals recorded on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the approval timestamp falls after the letter issue date or the band is insufficient.
generic.Exception handling path: Drafts missing consumer content are returned to the drafter rather than approved conditionally.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An approval record naming an approver within authority is dated before the letter issue date.
generic.Evidence location: Approval workflow record on the claim in ClaimCenter with counsel input on the legal matter.

steps.title: Route the draft denial through the ClaimCenter approval workflow
sop: Submit the versioned draft into the denial approval workflow.
Confirm the workflow captures approver identity and timestamp.
Done when the draft is in the approval queue with a workflow record.
verify: Open the workflow record for the draft.
Pass when it names the draft version and awaits an approver.

steps.title: Confirm approver authority covers the denied exposure
sop: Compare the denied exposure amount to the approval authority bands.
Escalate to the next band where the exposure exceeds the current one.
Done when an approver within the correct band holds the item.
verify: Compare the approver band to the exposure value.
Pass when the approver authority covers the exposure.

steps.title: Verify each cited provision exists as endorsed
sop: Open the policy documents and check each quoted provision and citation.
Record any inaccuracy as a workflow comment rather than editing the draft.
Done when every citation is checked and discrepancies commented.
verify: Re-check two quotations against the forms as endorsed.
Pass when both match the policy.

steps.title: Verify each factual ground is evidenced in the file
sop: Open the denial basis memo and follow each document ID cited.
Comment on any ground whose evidence does not support it.
Done when every ground has been traced to its evidence.
verify: Sample two grounds and open their cited documents.
Pass when the documents support the grounds as stated.

steps.title: Confirm consumer content and appeal rights are present
sop: Check the draft against the jurisdiction consumer content checklist.
Comment on any missing appeal route, time limit or regulator contact.
Done when the consumer content check is complete.
verify: Compare the draft to the checklist item by item.
Pass when every checklist item appears in the draft.

steps.title: Hold despatch until status shows Approved to Issue
sop: Close every approver comment with an amendment or a recorded response.
Do not despatch until the workflow status reads Approved to Issue.
Done when the status is set and no comment remains open.
verify: Compare the approval timestamp to the letter issue date.
Pass when approval predates issue and no comment remained open at approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: New evidence or legal authority submitted after the denial and each original denial ground.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the new material to issue of the written re-evaluation outcome.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt date, material indexed, per-ground assessment and decision are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Original denial grounds equal grounds assessed against the new material.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: New material indexed to the claim with its receipt date and document ID.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Grounds that fall away are logged with the effect on the remaining grounds.
generic.Test population: All denial re-evaluations recorded on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any original ground is not assessed against the new material.
generic.Exception handling path: New legal authority from the governing jurisdiction routes to coverage counsel before deciding.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The re-evaluation note addresses each original ground against the new evidence with a dated decision.
generic.Evidence location: Re-evaluation note in the coverage section of the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Index the new evidence or authority with its receipt date
sop: Upload the submitted material to the claim file with a document ID.
Record the date it was received and the party that submitted it.
Done when the material is indexed with a receipt date.
verify: Open the indexed document and check its receipt date.
Pass when the material resolves by ID and carries a receipt date.

steps.title: Test the material against each denial ground separately
sop: Take each original ground and state whether the material defeats, weakens or leaves it intact.
Record the reasoning in one short paragraph per ground.
Done when every ground carries an assessment.
verify: Count original grounds against assessments recorded.
Pass when the counts agree with no ground unassessed.

steps.title: Route new legal authority to coverage counsel
sop: Where the material is authority from the governing jurisdiction, raise it with coverage counsel.
Record counsel input before the re-evaluation decision is made.
Done when counsel input is recorded or the material is confirmed non legal.
verify: Check for counsel input where legal authority was submitted.
Pass when no legal authority was decided without counsel input.

steps.title: Decide whether remaining grounds still support the denial
sop: Where a ground falls away, assess whether the remaining grounds independently support denial.
Record the conclusion and the grounds it now rests on.
Done when the sufficiency conclusion is recorded.
verify: Read the conclusion against the surviving grounds.
Pass when the conclusion follows from the grounds that survive.

steps.title: Record the dated re-evaluation decision on the claim
sop: Record the decision as denial maintained or denial withdrawn with the date.
Update the exposure disposition where the denial is withdrawn.
Done when decision and disposition are recorded.
verify: Compare the exposure disposition to the recorded decision.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Issue the written outcome to the insured
sop: Where maintained, state the reasons and the grounds relied on.
Where withdrawn, state the next steps and the payment timetable.
Despatch and record the outcome letter on the claim.
Done when the outcome letter is despatched and recorded.
verify: Check the correspondence log for the outcome letter.
Pass when a dated outcome letter matching the decision is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each argument the insured raised in the dispute or appeal against the coverage decision.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the dispute to despatch of the substantive response within the deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Argument list, response per argument, position outcome and despatch date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Arguments raised equal arguments answered in the response letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Response letter version and despatch proof retained against the dispute record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Arguments not answered are logged with the reason and addressed in a supplement.
generic.Test population: All dispute responses issued on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any raised argument is unanswered or the response falls after the deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Arguments raising new legal issues route to coverage counsel before the response is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A dated response letter addresses each raised argument and was sent within the deadline.
generic.Evidence location: Dispute record and correspondence log on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: List each argument the insured raised
sop: Read the dispute correspondence and number each distinct argument raised.
Record the list on the dispute record so the response can be reconciled to it.
Done when every argument is numbered and recorded.
verify: Re-read the dispute against the numbered list.
Pass when no argument in the correspondence is missing from the list.

steps.title: Answer each argument explicitly in the response letter
sop: Write a response paragraph for each numbered argument in the same order.
Do not group arguments together in a single general answer.
Done when every numbered argument has its own answer.
verify: Map response paragraphs to the numbered argument list.
Pass when every argument number appears in the response.

steps.title: Include supplemental analysis and enclosable documents
sop: Add the supplemental analysis performed since the original decision.
Enclose copies of documents the insured is entitled to receive.
Do not enclose privileged or third party restricted material.
Done when the analysis and permitted enclosures are attached.
verify: Check the enclosure list against the privilege and privacy review.
Pass when no privileged or restricted document is enclosed.

steps.title: State whether the original position is maintained, varied or withdrawn
sop: State the outcome clearly in one sentence near the start of the letter.
State the basis for the outcome with the provisions relied on.
Done when the outcome and its basis are stated.
verify: Read the letter for an unambiguous outcome statement.
Pass when the outcome is stated once and consistently.

steps.title: Set out the remaining escalation routes
sop: List internal review, ombudsman or department of insurance, appraisal and the suit limitation period.
State any time limit attaching to each route.
Done when the escalation routes and their limits appear in the letter.
verify: Compare the routes listed to the jurisdiction requirements.
Pass when every required route is stated with its time limit.

steps.title: Despatch by a tracked method and stop the response clock
sop: Despatch the response by a tracked method and save the proof.
Record the response date against the dispute record to stop the clock.
Done when despatch proof and response date are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded response date to the response deadline.
Pass when the response was despatched on or before the deadline with proof saved.

generic.Defined scope/population: Denials subject to unfair claims practices review for the governing jurisdiction.
generic.In-scope period: From acknowledgment of the claim to the denial letter issue date for timeframe testing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Specificity check, timeframe checks, investigation check and review outcome are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Denials issued in the period equal denials with a completed compliance review record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review record retained with the dates tested and the letter version reviewed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Breaches are logged with the remediation and the owner assigned.
generic.Test population: All denials issued on claims during the review period for that jurisdiction.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any jurisdictional timeframe was missed or the letter lacks provision-and-basis specificity.
generic.Exception handling path: Breaches route to remediation and to complaint root-cause reporting in the GRC platform.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The review record confirms provision-and-basis specificity and timeframe adherence for the jurisdiction.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance review record on the claim in ClaimCenter and the GRC platform pack.

steps.title: Confirm the letter states the specific provision and factual basis
sop: Read the denial letter for the policy provision cited and the facts engaging it.
Reject a general statement of denial without provision and basis.
Done when the specificity test result is recorded.
verify: Read the letter as a regulator examiner would.
Pass when both a provision and a factual basis are stated for each ground.

steps.title: Test acknowledgment, investigation and decision timeframes
sop: Take the documented dates on the file for acknowledgment, investigation and decision.
Compare each interval to the jurisdiction requirement and record pass or fail.
Done when all three timeframe tests are recorded.
verify: Recompute each interval from the file dates.
Pass when each interval meets the jurisdiction requirement or is recorded as a breach.

steps.title: Confirm a reasonable investigation preceded the denial
sop: List the lines of enquiry opened and confirm each material one was closed.
Record any material enquiry left open at the denial date.
Done when the investigation completeness test is recorded.
verify: Compare open activities at the denial date to the grounds relied on.
Pass when no ground rested on an enquiry still open at denial.

steps.title: Check the correspondence for misrepresentation or underpayment pressure
sop: Read the outbound correspondence for any misstatement of policy terms.
Check the insured was not invited to accept less than the amount due.
Done when the correspondence review result is recorded.
verify: Sample two outbound letters against the policy terms.
Pass when no letter misstates a policy term or pressures acceptance.

steps.title: Record the compliance review outcome and remediation
sop: Record the overall outcome as compliant or breach with the failed test named.
Record the remediation action and its owner where a breach is found.
Done when outcome and remediation are recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the review record for outcome and remediation.
Pass when every breach carries a remediation action and owner.

steps.title: Publish the review into the GRC compliance pack
sop: Record the review result in the GRC platform against the market conduct control.
Attach the evidence of the tests performed with the as-at date.
Done when the review appears in the GRC pack with evidence.
verify: Open the GRC control record for this review period.
Pass when the review result and its evidence are present and dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Denied claims requiring a follow-up review for appeal, complaint or new evidence.
generic.In-scope period: From the denial issue date to the end of the appeal window and the suit limitation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Follow-up date, suit limitation date, check description, owner and claim status are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Denied claims in the period equal denied claims carrying an open follow-up diary.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Diary records retained with creation dates and the denial letter appeal window cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Diaries closed early are logged with the reason and the checks performed.
generic.Test population: All claims denied during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the follow-up date falls after the stated appeal window or the diary has no owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Files at risk of auto-purge before the follow-up date are held in a preserving status.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An open diary dated at or before the end of the appeal window exists with a named owner.
generic.Evidence location: Diary list on the denied claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Read the appeal window stated in the denial letter
sop: Open the issued denial letter and read the reconsideration or appeal window stated to the insured.
Record the window end date on the claim.
Done when the appeal window end date is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded end date to the letter wording.
Pass when the recorded date matches the window stated to the insured.

steps.title: Set the follow-up diary at the end of the appeal window
sop: Create a follow up diary dated at or before the appeal window end.
Title it with the claim decision it protects.
Done when the follow up diary is open with a due date.
verify: Compare the diary due date to the appeal window end.
Pass when the diary falls on or before the window end.

steps.title: Set a second diary at the contractual suit-limitation date
sop: Take the suit limitation date from the policy conditions review.
Create a diary with lead time before that date so the file is reviewed first.
Done when the suit limitation diary is open.
verify: Compare the diary date to the suit limitation date.
Pass when the diary fires before the limitation date.

steps.title: Record what will be checked at follow-up
sop: Record the checks as no appeal received, no regulator complaint and no new evidence.
Record where each check will be performed so the diary can be closed cleanly.
Done when the check list is recorded on the diary.
verify: Read the diary for its check list.
Pass when the diary states what must be true before it can be closed.

steps.title: Hold the claim in a status that prevents auto-purge
sop: Set or confirm a claim status that preserves the file until the follow up dates pass.
Check the retention rule applying to closed denied claims.
Done when the claim status preserves the file past the last diary date.
verify: Compare the purge date under the current status to the last diary date.
Pass when the purge date falls after the last diary.

steps.title: Assign the diaries and confirm they appear on the team report
sop: Assign each diary to a named owner rather than a queue.
Run the team diary report and confirm both diaries appear.
Done when the diaries are assigned and visible on the report.
verify: Search the team diary report for this claim.
Pass when both diaries appear with a named owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: The claim handling, reserve and settlement strategy affected by the coverage opinion received.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the opinion to the dated strategy and reserve update on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage position, reserve values, settlement range and strategy update date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reserved questions the opinion resolves equal ROR rows closed or supplemented.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Strategy update note dated and cross referenced to the opinion document and matter number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Opinion conclusions not adopted are logged with the reason and the approval obtained.
generic.Test population: All claims receiving a coverage opinion during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if no dated strategy or reserve update references the opinion outcome.
generic.Exception handling path: Reserve changes above authority route to the manager before the strategy is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The claim shows a dated strategy and reserve update referencing the coverage opinion outcome.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage log and reserve history on the claim in ClaimCenter with the matter in the legal system.

steps.title: Update the coverage position to the opinion conclusion
sop: Read the opinion conclusion for each numbered question referred.
Update the coverage position field on the claim and stamp the date the strategy changed.
Done when the position and change date are saved.
verify: Compare the saved position to the opinion conclusion.
Pass when the position matches the opinion or a recorded reason explains the difference.

steps.title: Adjust indemnity and expense reserves to the supported range
sop: Set the indemnity reserve to the exposure range the opinion supports.
Set the expense reserve to the anticipated legal and adjustment spend.
Document the reserve rationale referencing the opinion outcome.
Done when both reserves and the rationale are saved.
verify: Compare the reserve values to the range stated in the opinion.
Pass when the reserves fall inside the supported range.

steps.title: Update the settlement authority request or negotiation range
sop: Recalculate the negotiation range in line with the coverage risk the opinion identifies.
Submit an updated authority request where the new range exceeds current authority.
Done when the negotiation range is updated and any request is submitted.
verify: Compare the new range to the current settlement authority.
Pass when the range is within authority or an updated request exists.

steps.title: Trigger ROR withdrawal or supplement for resolved questions
sop: Identify the reserved questions the opinion resolves.
Raise the withdrawal or supplement action rather than leaving the reservation open.
Done when each resolved reservation has a withdrawal or supplement action.
verify: Compare resolved questions to ROR actions raised.
Pass when no question resolved by the opinion remains reserved without action.

steps.title: Record handling instructions in the non-privileged coverage log
sop: Write the handling steps to take without reproducing counsel reasoning.
Reference the matter number rather than quoting the privileged analysis.
Done when the non privileged instruction entry is saved.
verify: Read the entry for reproduced legal analysis.
Pass when the entry directs handling without disclosing privileged reasoning.

steps.title: Diary the next strategy checkpoint on the matter
sop: Set a diary for the next strategy review driven by the litigation or negotiation timetable.
Link the diary to the legal matter so counsel input is available at the checkpoint.
Done when the checkpoint diary is open with an owner.
verify: Check the claim diary list for the strategy checkpoint.
Pass when an open dated diary with an owner exists.

generic.Defined scope/population: The coverage counsel referral matter for this claim and its open financial and hold items.
generic.In-scope period: From delivery of the final opinion to the matter status being set to Closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Opinion filed flag, final invoice status, accrual balance, hold status and closure reason are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Legal expense reserve released equals actual paid on the matter with no residual accrual.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Opinion and addenda filed to the privileged folder with dates before closure.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Held invoices or disputed fees are logged with the resolution before closure.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any open accrual or unpaid invoice remains once the matter status is Closed.
generic.Exception handling path: Matters with a live litigation hold stay open or record the hold maintenance decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No open accrual or unpaid invoice remains once the matter status is set to Closed.
generic.Evidence location: Matter record in the legal matter management system with the claim reserve history.

steps.title: Confirm the opinion and addenda are filed to the privileged folder
sop: Check the claim privileged folder for the written opinion and every addendum.
Upload any missing document before the matter is closed.
Done when the full opinion set is filed on the claim.
verify: Compare the matter document list to the claim privileged folder.
Pass when every opinion document exists on the claim.

steps.title: Request and confirm receipt of counsel final invoice
sop: Request the final invoice from counsel citing the matter number.
Confirm receipt and that counsel has marked it final.
Done when the final invoice is received and marked final.
verify: Check the matter for an invoice flagged final.
Pass when a final invoice is present and no further billing is expected.

steps.title: Confirm no accrual remains open on the matter
sop: Read the accrual balance on the matter in the e-billing system.
Clear or explain any residual accrual before closure.
Done when the accrual balance is zero or explained.
verify: Read the accrual field on the matter.
Pass when the balance is zero.

steps.title: Release the legal expense reserve to match actual paid
sop: Compare the legal expense reserve on the claim to actual paid on the matter.
Release the excess reserve and record the adjustment reason.
Done when the reserve equals actual paid.
verify: Compare the reserve balance to the matter paid total.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Release or expressly maintain any litigation hold
sop: Check whether a litigation hold was issued in connection with the referral.
Release the hold or record the decision to maintain it with the reason.
Done when the hold decision is recorded.
verify: Read the hold status on the claim.
Pass when the hold is either released or expressly maintained with a reason.

steps.title: Set the matter status to Closed with a closure reason
sop: Set the matter status to Closed and select the closure reason.
Confirm the matter drops off the open matter report on the next run.
Done when the status is Closed and the report no longer lists it.
verify: Run the open matter report and search for this matter.
Pass when the matter is absent and its status reads Closed.

generic.Defined scope/population: The coverage opinion document and the non-privileged record of its application on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the opinion to completion of the privileged filing and log entry.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document type, privilege designation, access restriction and matter cross reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Opinions received equal opinions filed with a privilege designation applied.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Opinion filed with upload date and version in the restricted privileged folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed restrictions are logged and remediated before any further distribution.
generic.Test population: All coverage opinions filed on claims during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the opinion is stored outside the restricted folder or lacks the privilege designation.
generic.Exception handling path: Opinions found in outbound templates are removed and the distribution is reviewed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The opinion is stored in the restricted privileged folder with the privilege designation applied.
generic.Evidence location: Privileged legal folder of the claim file with the log entry on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Upload the opinion to the privileged legal folder
sop: Upload the opinion to the claim privileged or legal folder.
Set the document type to Coverage Opinion.
Done when the opinion is uploaded with the correct document type.
verify: Open the folder and check the document type on the entry.
Pass when the document sits in the privileged folder typed as Coverage Opinion.

steps.title: Apply the privilege designation to the document
sop: Mark the document Attorney-Client Privileged and Attorney Work Product.
Apply the access restriction the repository provides for privileged material.
Done when both the designation and the restriction are applied.
verify: Attempt to open the document from an unrestricted claim role.
Pass when the document is inaccessible to unrestricted roles.

steps.title: Confirm the restriction actually applies in the repository
sop: Test the restriction using a role without privileged access.
Raise a remediation where the document is visible to that role.
Done when the restriction is confirmed effective.
verify: Read the document access list on the entry.
Pass when only privileged roles appear on the access list.

steps.title: Write the non-privileged coverage log entry
sop: Record that an opinion was obtained, its date and the resulting handling direction.
Do not summarise counsel reasoning in the non privileged entry.
Done when the short non privileged entry is saved.
verify: Read the entry for reproduced analysis.
Pass when the entry records the fact and direction without the reasoning.

steps.title: Cross-reference the legal matter number on the claim
sop: Record the legal matter number on the claim legal panel.
Record the claim number on the matter so the link works both ways.
Done when both references are recorded.
verify: Follow the reference from claim to matter and back.
Pass when both directions resolve.

steps.title: Confirm the opinion is not attached to any outbound template
sop: Check the correspondence templates and enclosure sets used on this claim.
Remove the opinion from any enclosure list that could reach a claimant or other carrier.
Done when no outbound template carries the opinion.
verify: Generate an enclosure preview for the next outbound letter.
Pass when the opinion does not appear in the enclosure list.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims tested against the coverage counsel referral triggers for complexity and exposure.
generic.In-scope period: From coverage analysis completion to the next imminent response deadline on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Referral indicator, qualifying trigger, exposure value and trigger date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims meeting a trigger equal claims with the referral indicator set or a recorded exception.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Trigger assessment retained on the claim with the exposure figure as at the assessment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims meeting a trigger but not referred are logged with the approval to proceed unreferred.
generic.Test population: All claims assessed against referral triggers during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the referral indicator is set without a recorded qualifying trigger.
generic.Exception handling path: Triggers identified after a position was communicated escalate to the manager immediately.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The coverage-counsel referral indicator is set with the qualifying trigger recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Referral indicator panel and trigger note on the claim in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Test the claim against each referral trigger
sop: Compare the exposure to the large loss threshold and to any policy limits demand.
Check whether a coverage denial rests on a disputed ground.
Record the result of each trigger test on the claim.
Done when every trigger has a recorded test result.
verify: Read the trigger results against the exposure and file facts.
Pass when every trigger carries a result rather than a blank.

steps.title: Flag declaratory judgment, bad-faith and regulator complaint indicators
sop: Search the claim for a declaratory judgment action, bad faith allegation or regulator complaint.
Set the referral flag automatically where any of these appear.
Done when these three indicators are checked and recorded.
verify: Compare the file correspondence to the recorded indicators.
Pass when any such document on the file has set the referral flag.

steps.title: Flag novel wording and conflicting authority
sop: Review the case law research output for conflicting or absent authority.
Flag novel or untested wording and multi jurisdiction exposure.
Done when wording and jurisdiction complexity are assessed and recorded.
verify: Compare the research output to the complexity flags set.
Pass when conflicting authority identified in research is reflected in a flag.

steps.title: Set the referral indicator with the trigger recorded
sop: Set the coverage counsel referral indicator on the claim.
Record which trigger qualified so referral volumes can be reported by trigger.
Done when the indicator and trigger are saved.
verify: Read the indicator and its recorded trigger.
Pass when the indicator carries a qualifying trigger value.

steps.title: Confirm the referral precedes any imminent response deadline
sop: List the response deadlines open on the claim.
Raise the referral before the earliest deadline rather than after the position is communicated.
Done when the referral date precedes the earliest deadline.
verify: Compare the referral date to the earliest open deadline.
Pass when the referral was raised before the deadline.

steps.title: Log exceptions where a trigger is met but no referral is raised
sop: Where a trigger is met and no referral is raised, record the reason.
Obtain and record the approval to proceed without a referral.
Done when every unreferred trigger has a reason and an approval.
verify: List claims with a met trigger and no referral.
Pass when each has a recorded reason and approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: The facts, policy wording and coverage questions to be put to counsel for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the referral trigger being set to submission of the memo to counsel.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Chronology, provisions quoted, jurisdiction, numbered questions and exhibit index are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibits listed in the index equal documents attached to the memo package.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Memo saved to the claim file with its version and the privileged marking applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Facts that remain unverified are logged as such rather than presented as established.
generic.Test population: All coverage referral memos prepared during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the memo lacks numbered questions, the governing jurisdiction or an exhibit index.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing exhibits are obtained before submission or listed as outstanding with a date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The memo contains numbered coverage questions, the governing jurisdiction and an exhibit index.
generic.Evidence location: Referral memo in the coverage section of the claim file.

steps.title: Set out the loss chronology with an evidence source per fact
sop: Write the chronology of the loss with dates in order.
Name the evidence source for each fact stated in the chronology.
Mark any fact that remains unverified.
Done when the chronology is complete with sources and verification status.
verify: Sample three chronology facts and open their sources.
Pass when each fact resolves to the source named.

steps.title: Quote the provisions at issue with form number and edition
sop: Quote each provision in full from the form as endorsed.
List every endorsement that amends the quoted provisions.
Done when the wording section is complete with citations.
verify: Compare each quotation to the retrieved forms.
Pass when each quotation and citation matches the policy as endorsed.

steps.title: State the governing jurisdiction and any choice-of-law argument
sop: State the governing jurisdiction and the basis for it.
Note any choice of law argument the insured may run and its effect.
Done when jurisdiction and any competing argument are stated.
verify: Read the jurisdiction section for a stated basis.
Pass when the jurisdiction is named with a reason rather than assumed.

steps.title: List the numbered coverage questions with their deadlines
sop: Number each question on which an opinion is required.
State the deadline driving each question and what drives it.
Done when every question is numbered and carries a deadline.
verify: Read each question for answerability and a deadline.
Pass when no question is unnumbered or undated.

steps.title: Attach the exhibit index and the exhibits
sop: Index the declarations, forms, statements, reports, correspondence and any ROR or denial letters.
Attach each indexed exhibit to the memo package.
Done when every index entry has an attached exhibit or an outstanding marker.
verify: Compare index entries to attached documents.
Pass when the counts agree or outstanding items are dated.

steps.title: Mark the memo privileged and save it to the claim file
sop: Apply the privileged marking and the access restriction to the memo.
Save the memo with a version number to the coverage section of the claim file.
Done when the marked memo is saved and restricted.
verify: Attempt to open the memo from an unrestricted role.
Pass when access is restricted and the memo carries the privileged marking.

generic.Defined scope/population: The complete production set of claim, policy and investigation materials for counsel.
generic.In-scope period: From referral instruction to counsel confirmation of receipt and completeness.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Manifest, redaction review status, transfer date, recipient and receipt confirmation are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents on the manifest equal documents delivered and acknowledged by counsel.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Transfer record retained with the manifest, delivery date and receipt confirmation.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents withheld or redacted are logged with the reason on the manifest.
generic.Test population: All counsel production packages delivered during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the transfer record lacks a manifest, delivery date or receipt confirmation.
generic.Exception handling path: Follow-up items counsel requests are diarised rather than handled informally.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The transfer record lists the manifest, the secure delivery date and counsel receipt confirmation.
generic.Evidence location: Transfer record on the claim with the package on the matter in the legal matter system.

steps.title: Compile the production set from the claim file
sop: Compile the full claim notes, policy documents as endorsed, statements, expert reports and photographs.
Add every outbound letter issued on the claim.
Done when the production set is assembled in the repository.
verify: Compare the assembled set to the claim file document list.
Pass when no category of claim document is missing from the set.

steps.title: Include the adverse material in the package
sop: Identify contradicting statements and unfavourable expert findings on the file.
Include them in the package rather than curating a favourable set.
Done when adverse material is confirmed present in the package.
verify: Search the package for the known adverse documents.
Pass when each adverse document identified is in the package.

steps.title: Apply the retention and privacy redaction review
sop: Review the package for unrelated third party personal data.
Redact that data and record each redaction on the manifest.
Done when the redaction review is complete and logged.
verify: Sample two redacted documents against the manifest entries.
Pass when each redaction is recorded with a reason.

steps.title: Build the manifest of package contents
sop: List every document in the package with its document ID and type.
Note any document withheld with the reason.
Done when the manifest covers the package and the withheld list.
verify: Count manifest rows against package documents.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Deliver via secure transfer and record the transfer
sop: Deliver the package through the secure file transfer or legal matter portal.
Record the transfer date, recipient and the manifest against the claim.
Done when the delivery is complete and the transfer record is saved.
verify: Read the transfer record for date, recipient and manifest.
Pass when all three are recorded and the delivery route was secure.

steps.title: Obtain counsel confirmation of receipt and completeness
sop: Ask counsel to confirm receipt and that the package is complete.
Diary any follow up items counsel requests with a named owner.
Done when the confirmation is recorded and follow ups are diarised.
verify: Read the transfer record for counsel confirmation.
Pass when confirmation is recorded and every requested item has a diary.

generic.Defined scope/population: The engagement of the selected coverage counsel for the numbered questions on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From selection of counsel to execution of the engagement and opening of the e-billing profile.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Scope, rates, rate freeze, budget, authority cap and conflict clearance are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rates in the engagement equal rates loaded to the e-billing profile for each timekeeper.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed engagement letter attached to the matter with its execution date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rate or budget exceptions agreed are logged with the approval that permitted them.
generic.Test population: All coverage counsel engagements executed during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the engagement lacks agreed rates, a budget or a written conflict clearance.
generic.Exception handling path: Budget breaches require approval before counsel continues rather than after invoicing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An executed engagement with rates, budget and conflict clearance is attached to the matter.
generic.Evidence location: Matter record in the legal matter management system with the reference on the claim.

steps.title: Issue the engagement letter with scope limited to the questions
sop: Draft the engagement letter limiting scope to the numbered coverage questions.
State the agreed deliverable and its due date.
Done when the engagement letter is issued to counsel.
verify: Compare the scope wording to the referral memo question set.
Pass when the scope matches the numbered questions.

steps.title: Attach billing guidelines and confirm rates in writing
sop: Attach the outside counsel billing guidelines to the engagement.
Confirm the hourly rate for each timekeeper and any rate freeze period in writing.
Done when guidelines and rates are agreed in writing.
verify: Compare the agreed rate schedule to the guidelines.
Pass when each timekeeper rate is recorded and within guideline.

steps.title: Set the matter budget and authority cap
sop: Set the budget for the matter and the authority cap on spend.
State that approval is required before the cap is exceeded.
Done when budget and cap are recorded on the matter.
verify: Read the budget and cap on the matter record.
Pass when both are populated and the approval requirement is stated.

steps.title: Obtain written conflict clearance covering all parties
sop: Ask counsel to clear conflicts against the insured, all additional insureds and the other carriers.
Obtain the clearance in writing before instructing.
Done when the written clearance is received and filed.
verify: Compare the parties cleared to the claim party and carrier lists.
Pass when every party on the claim appears in the clearance.

steps.title: Record the executed engagement against the matter
sop: Attach the executed engagement letter to the matter with its execution date.
Record the matter reference on the claim.
Done when the executed engagement is attached and cross referenced.
verify: Open the engagement from the claim reference.
Pass when the executed letter opens and shows signature and date.

steps.title: Open the e-billing profile with guideline checking enabled
sop: Create the e-billing profile for the matter and load the agreed rates.
Enable guideline checking so invoices route through automated review.
Done when the profile exists with rates loaded and checking enabled.
verify: Submit a test invoice validation against the profile.
Pass when off agreement rates are rejected by the profile.

generic.Defined scope/population: The coverage opinion document subject to the document retention schedule for this line and jurisdiction.
generic.In-scope period: From filing of the opinion to the calculated disposal date under the retention schedule.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document class, retention schedule, clock start date, disposal date and hold status are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Opinions filed equal opinions carrying a retention class and a computed disposal date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive reference recorded on the claim with the retention class and disposal date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Opinions under litigation hold are logged with the hold overriding the disposal date.
generic.Test population: All coverage opinions archived during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the disposal date is absent or the privilege restriction did not survive the move.
generic.Exception handling path: Where the schedule is ambiguous, the longest applicable period is applied and the choice recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The opinion carries a retention class, disposal date and an intact privilege restriction.
generic.Evidence location: Document record in OpenText Document Mgmt with the archive reference on the claim.

steps.title: Set the document class to Coverage Opinion
sop: Open the opinion record in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Set the document class to Coverage Opinion so the retention rule attaches.
Done when the class is set and the retention rule is shown.
verify: Read the class and attached retention rule on the record.
Pass when the class is Coverage Opinion with a rule attached.

steps.title: Confirm the schedule applied is the longest applicable period
sop: Compare the retention periods for this line and jurisdiction.
Apply the longest applicable period and record why it was chosen.
Done when the applied period and its rationale are recorded.
verify: Compare the applied period to the candidate periods listed.
Pass when the applied period is the longest of those applicable.

steps.title: Confirm the retention clock start date
sop: Check whether the schedule runs from claim closure or document creation.
Set the clock start date accordingly on the document record.
Done when the clock start date matches the schedule requirement.
verify: Recompute the disposal date from the clock start and the period.
Pass when the computed disposal date matches the record.

steps.title: Verify the privilege designation survives the archive move
sop: Open the archived record and check the privilege designation and access restriction.
Reapply either if the move stripped them.
Done when both survive on the archived record.
verify: Attempt to open the archived opinion from an unrestricted role.
Pass when access is denied and the designation is visible to privileged roles.

steps.title: Confirm any litigation hold overrides the disposal date
sop: Check whether a litigation hold is in force on the claim.
Confirm the hold is recorded against the document and suspends disposal.
Done when the hold status on the document is correct.
verify: Read the disposal status on a held document.
Pass when the disposal action is suspended while the hold is in force.

steps.title: Record the archive reference on the claim
sop: Record the archive reference and disposal date on the claim legal panel.
Confirm the reference retrieves the document for a market conduct exam.
Done when the reference is recorded and retrieval is proven.
verify: Retrieve the opinion using the recorded archive reference.
Pass when the reference returns the opinion document.

generic.Defined scope/population: All coverage counsel invoices submitted on this matter against the engagement terms.
generic.In-scope period: The billing period of each invoice measured against the engagement and budget.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Timekeeper rates, guideline breach flags, disbursements, budget position and disposition are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved plus reduced plus disputed amounts equal the invoice gross for each invoice.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Invoice, review working and disposition retained on the matter with the review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reductions and disputes are logged with reason codes on each line adjusted.
generic.Test population: All coverage counsel invoices dispositioned during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an invoice is approved with an off-agreement rate or without a budget check.
generic.Exception handling path: Invoices breaching the budget are held for approval before any part is approved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each invoice carries a recorded disposition with approved and reduced amounts and reason codes.
generic.Evidence location: Invoice records on the matter in the legal matter management and e-billing system.

steps.title: Check timekeeper rates against the engagement letter
sop: Compare each timekeeper rate on the invoice to the agreed rate schedule.
Reject lines billed at off agreement rates with the reason code.
Done when every timekeeper rate is checked.
verify: Sample two timekeepers and compare to the engagement schedule.
Pass when no approved line carries an off agreement rate.

steps.title: Review for guideline breaches in the narratives
sop: Check for block billing, multiple attorneys on one call, clerical time and internal conferencing.
Flag each breach against its line with the guideline clause breached.
Done when the narrative review is complete and breaches are flagged.
verify: Sample flagged lines against the billing guidelines.
Pass when each flag cites a guideline clause.

steps.title: Check disbursements against the guidelines
sop: Check for photocopy, secretarial and overtime mark ups that the guidelines exclude.
Check travel costs fall within the travel policy.
Done when every disbursement line is checked and dispositioned.
verify: List approved disbursements against the excluded categories.
Pass when no excluded category is approved.

steps.title: Reconcile cumulative billed to the approved budget
sop: Add the invoice to the cumulative billed on the matter.
Flag the invoice where it would breach the approved budget.
Hold the invoice for approval rather than approving into a breach.
Done when the budget position is computed and any breach is flagged.
verify: Recompute cumulative billed against the budget.
Pass when no invoice is approved that breaches the budget without approval.

steps.title: Record approved, reduced and disputed amounts with reason codes
sop: Record the disposition per line with approved, reduced and disputed values.
Attach a reduction reason code to every reduced or disputed line.
Done when the invoice disposition is complete.
verify: Sum the three values and compare to the invoice gross.
Pass when the totals reconcile and every reduction has a reason code.

steps.title: Update the legal expense reserve on the claim
sop: Compare the approved amount and remaining budget to the legal expense reserve.
Adjust the reserve and record the rationale.
Done when the reserve reflects the approved spend and remaining budget.
verify: Compare the reserve to paid plus remaining budget.
Pass when the reserve covers the remaining expected spend.

generic.Defined scope/population: Panel firms qualifying to advise on this claim in the governing jurisdiction and line.
generic.In-scope period: From the referral being raised to selection of the instructed firm.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Panel status, admission, performance data, conflict result and selection rationale are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Firms shortlisted equal firms conflict checked before the referral memo is sent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Selection record retained with the panel filter used and the conflict clearance date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Off-panel instructions are logged with the documented exception approval.
generic.Test population: All coverage counsel selections made during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the instructed firm is off panel with no recorded exception or has no cleared conflict check.
generic.Exception handling path: A coverage conflict with defence counsel disqualifies the firm rather than being managed informally.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The selected firm is on panel or has a recorded exception, with a cleared conflict check on the matter.
generic.Evidence location: Selection record on the matter in the legal matter management system.

steps.title: Filter the approved panel for jurisdiction and line experience
sop: Filter the panel to firms admitted in the governing jurisdiction.
Narrow to firms experienced in coverage disputes on this line.
Done when the qualifying shortlist is recorded.
verify: Check each shortlisted firm admission and line experience.
Pass when every shortlisted firm meets both criteria.

steps.title: Check panel performance data before choosing
sop: Compare cycle time, budget adherence and outcome history for the shortlisted firms.
Record the comparison used to choose between them.
Done when the performance comparison is recorded.
verify: Read the comparison against the panel performance report.
Pass when the recorded data matches the panel report.

steps.title: Run the conflict check against all parties on the claim
sop: Provide the insured, additional insureds, claimants and other carriers to the firm for checking.
Obtain the conflict result before sending the referral memo.
Done when the conflict result is received and recorded.
verify: Compare the parties checked to the claim party and carrier lists.
Pass when every party was included in the check.

steps.title: Confirm the firm is not defence counsel on the same claim
sop: Check the defence counsel assignment on the claim.
Disqualify the firm where acting as defence counsel would create a coverage conflict.
Done when the defence conflict test is recorded.
verify: Compare the selected firm to the defence assignment.
Pass when the two are different firms or the conflict is cleared in writing.

steps.title: Record the off-panel exception approval where required
sop: Where no panel firm qualifies, document why and seek the off panel exception approval.
Record the approval before instructing the firm.
Done when the exception approval is recorded or a panel firm is selected.
verify: Check the matter for panel status or an exception approval.
Pass when one of the two is present before instruction.

steps.title: Record the selection and rationale on the matter
sop: Record the firm selected, the shortlist and the reason for the choice.
Attach the conflict clearance to the matter record.
Done when the selection record is complete on the matter.
verify: Open the matter selection record.
Pass when it names the firm, the rationale and carries the cleared conflict check.

generic.Defined scope/population: The counsel opinion timeline on this matter measured against the regulatory response deadline.
generic.In-scope period: From instruction of counsel to receipt of the opinion or the regulatory deadline, whichever falls first.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Regulatory deadline, opinion due date, chase diary date and actual turnaround are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open counsel opinions equal matters with an opinion due date and an open chase diary.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Status updates logged on the matter with the date of each reporting interval.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late opinions are logged with the interim communication issued to the insured.
generic.Test population: All coverage opinion matters open during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the opinion due date is not earlier than the recorded regulatory response deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Where the opinion will be late, an interim status communication is issued before the deadline lapses.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The matter shows an opinion due date earlier than the regulatory deadline with an open chase diary.
generic.Evidence location: Matter tracking record in the legal matter system with the deadline recorded on the claim.

steps.title: Record the regulatory contact-and-response deadline on the claim
sop: Identify the jurisdiction contact and response deadline for this line.
Record the deadline date on the claim compliance panel.
Done when the regulatory deadline is recorded.
verify: Recompute the deadline from the triggering date.
Pass when the recorded deadline follows the jurisdiction rule.

steps.title: Set the counsel opinion due date ahead of the deadline
sop: Set the opinion due date at least five business days before the regulatory deadline.
Record the due date on the matter and confirm counsel accepts it.
Done when the due date is recorded and accepted.
verify: Compare the opinion due date to the regulatory deadline.
Pass when the due date is at least five business days earlier.

steps.title: Set the due-date diary and a midpoint chase diary
sop: Create a diary on the matter for the opinion due date.
Create a second chase diary at the midpoint between instruction and due date.
Done when both diaries are open with named owners.
verify: List diaries on the matter.
Pass when both a due date diary and a midpoint chase diary are open.

steps.title: Log counsel status updates at each reporting interval
sop: Obtain the status update counsel owes at each interval in the billing guidelines.
Log each update on the matter with its date.
Chase where an interval passes without an update.
Done when every due interval has a logged update or a chase.
verify: Count the intervals elapsed against updates logged.
Pass when each elapsed interval has an update or a recorded chase.

steps.title: Issue the interim status communication where the opinion will be late
sop: Where counsel signals delay, prepare the interim status communication for the insured.
Issue it before the regulatory deadline rather than letting it lapse.
Done when the interim communication is issued and recorded.
verify: Compare the interim communication date to the regulatory deadline.
Pass when the communication was issued before the deadline.

steps.title: Close tracking on receipt and record the actual turnaround
sop: Close the tracking entry and the diaries on receipt of the opinion.
Record the actual turnaround against the target for panel performance reporting.
Done when tracking is closed and turnaround is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded turnaround against the target.
Pass when the actual turnaround is recorded and feeds the panel performance report.
